conventions.context_budget: Each stage reads only its listed doc ranges. Use the generated operation map instead of re-reading Docs/40 operation blocks (read a block only when a field's meaning is unclear). Use mobile/preview for copy and states instead of re-reading all of Docs/21. Copy the patterns of the first finished screen of a kind (master-detail, wizard, SSR profile) instead of re-deriving them.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-AUTH-01 puts the sign-in form in a 640 px modal; Docs/40 §6.2 requires credentials to be entered on the hosted sign-in UI of the authorization server, and SEC-WEB-4 forbids framing.
doc_issues.action: GD-06: context modal + redirect through the hosted sign-in, intent replayed on return. The hosted page uses the same W-AUTH-01 layout and shows the context line.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-COMP-01 lets car owners publish repair stories and tips; Docs/40 posts.create is ORG(P*, V*) only, and there is no consumer post operation.
doc_issues.action: Consumer composer limited to the Question type (questions.create) in P8; repair stories and tips are deferred until the contract adds a consumer post operation. Tell the backend owner.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-PUB-07 Member Page has no operation in Docs/40 (no public member read).
doc_issues.action: Deferred; review/answer author names render as text without a link until an operation exists.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-HELP-01 'Guest use' (and open point 2) lets guests run Help Me; Docs/40 triage.* are USR only.
doc_issues.action: Guests see the Help Me landing, are asked to sign in at the vehicle step (GD-06 intent), and can use search and the category picker without an account (OQ-04).

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 §6 shows search pages as /fa/search?… with filters in the URL; Docs/40 TR-7 keeps search text and coordinates out of URLs.
doc_issues.action: GD-14: search session id in the path, enumerated filters only in the query.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-NET-01 has tabs Saved posts, Saved parts and Saved searches, and W-PUB-05/W-FEED-01 have Save on posts; Docs/40 has follows.* and favorites.* (organizations) only.
doc_issues.action: Build Favourites and Following; hide Save on posts and the other tabs until operations exist.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-FEED-01 feed tabs (For you, Following, Nearby, Showcases, Tips, Q&A), 'Not interested' and the '3 new posts' pill assume a personalised timeline; Docs/40 has feed.discover (PUB) and per-org posts.public_list.
doc_issues.action: P8 reads feed.discover's input/output and builds the tabs it supports; others hidden and listed in the P8 report.
doc_issues.status: done in P8 (Discover only; the rest needs contract work, DI-52)

doc_issues.issue: Browsers upload media with a cross-origin signed PUT to the storage host (Docs/40 SEC-UP-1); backend's storage listener sends no CORS headers, so the preflight fails.
doc_issues.action: P7 adds CORS to the backend storage listener for configured web origins (PUT with the signed headers only, no credentials), with tests, and records it in backend/dev_plan.json. Production media host needs the same.
doc_issues.resolution: P7 (2026-10-26): CARPAL_MEDIA_CORS_ORIGINS on the backend; the lite storage listener answers CORS for those origins on PUT and GET (preflight, ACAO + Vary, no credentials). Production media host still needs the same rules (WP1).

doc_issues.issue: SEC-WEB-3 (Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site, CSRF) is not enforced on the auth host's /v1/auth/* endpoints.
doc_issues.action: The hosted UI sends the headers anyway; report to backend (strict-mode item).
doc_issues.note: P2: the PWA /id proxy refuses state changes whose Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site is not same-origin, so the dev topology has the check even though the auth host does not (production id.carpal.app still needs it in the backend).

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-SRCH-01/W-PUB-02 'Call' reveals a number and 'logs a contact event'; no operation is named for that event.
doc_issues.action: P5 checks search.result_event (event types) and the registered analytics events; uses whichever fits, otherwise events.ingest with a registered name.
doc_issues.resolution: Checked: search.result_event takes 'viewed'|'selected' only, and the backend analytics registry (CLIENT_EVENTS) has no contact event. Call reveal from a search result sends search.result_event 'selected'; elsewhere nothing is logged. Ask the backend owner to register profile.contact_revealed {target_type, entry_point} (GD-17 amendment).
doc_issues.p5: Built: Call on the profile loads the number on click and, when sessionStorage cp:search-origin names this organization (written by P6 result cards), sends search.result_event 'selected' once.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-NOTIF-01 offers consumer web push ('Get updates even when this tab is closed'); Docs/52 PushDeviceToken says web tokens serve provider and vendor portals and 'the consumer app does not receive business notifications'.
doc_issues.action: P12 checks push_tokens.register (platform enum) and the dispatcher; consumer web push is built if the contract allows platform web for a user, else hidden (OQ-07).
doc_issues.resolution: Checked: PushTokenRegister.platform includes 'web' for USR, and the backend dispatcher (modules/notification/application/dispatcher.ts) sends personal notifications to all of the user's tokens including web ones. Consumer web push is built in P12. Side effect recorded as DI-16.

doc_issues.issue: Design system README: 'the web bundle (JS + CSS) is under 20 KB unminified'. A Next.js app cannot meet that for the whole page.
doc_issues.action: The budget applies to the design-system component layer (ds/ + its CSS). Page budgets: LCP ≤ 2.5 s on a mid-range phone on 4G for public pages (Docs/22 principle 5), measured in P13.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-PUB-08 route /fa/parts/<vendor-slug>/<item-slug>; public.inventory_get is by item_id.
doc_issues.action: Route /<locale>/parts/<vendor-slug>/<item_id>-<item-slug>; a wrong slug 301s to the canonical one. Same pattern as posts and questions.

doc_issues.issue: cp-ssr tokens carry scope public.read only; directory pages (W-PUB-04) and SSR question lists call search.run / questions.search (RL(search)), and the anonymous scope is 'public.read search'.
doc_issues.action: P5/P6 test whether the backend accepts cp-ssr for these; if not, SSR uses a server-held anonymous token (GD-07).
doc_issues.resolution: P2 checked live: the backend enforces no token scopes per operation, so cp-ssr may call search.run (and questions.search). ssrApi still falls back to a server-held anonymous token on 401. Rate-limit side effect recorded as DI-26.

doc_issues.issue: Region config map URLs (shared/region-config/ir-pilot.json) are placeholders; no tile build exists.
doc_issues.action: GD-12 fallback style; OQ-02.

doc_issues.issue: The backend dispatcher sends business notifications (organization context) to the user's web push tokens only, and a consumer PWA token and a portal token are both platform 'web' (backend GD-24). A user who is also a business member would get business pushes through the consumer PWA.
doc_issues.action: P12: the PWA service worker opens notifications with organization_context_id in the portal (URL from config) instead of a PWA route, and the in-app list filters them out (notifications.list without organization_id lists personal ones). Ask the backend owner to tell consumer and portal web tokens apart (e.g. a 'web_portal' platform or the CarPal-Client of the registering call).

doc_issues.issue: The anonymous grant gives cp-web-consumer a token with a random subject unless the request carries a DPoP proof; the backend derives the anonymous key from cnf.jkt ?? sub, so every 15-minute renewal would make a guest a new anonymous principal: earlier search sessions answer 404/400 CURSOR_MISMATCH, Discover/feed pages restart and rate limits are no longer per device. Docs/40 SEC-AU-14 says only that consumer web visitors get the token 'through the BFF session'.
doc_issues.action: GD-07 amendment: one ES256 DPoP key per BFF pre-session, used for every anonymous grant of that pre-session (and for API proofs in strict mode). Search pages also re-run the stored search request when a session is no longer readable (GD-09 amendment 4).
doc_issues.note: P2: built and verified against the live backend (bff.int.test.ts: a guest search session is still refinable after an anonymous renewal).

doc_issues.issue: community.feed.enabled, community.comments.enabled and qna.enabled are seeded off (Docs/43 seeds, Should-have), and the only way to change a flag is admin.flag_update on the admin plane (staff aal3 with a device-bound passkey, ETAG). P8 development and its E2E need them on, and the PWA must not write SQL.
doc_issues.action: P8.T0: add a small dev-only backend CLI (e.g. `pnpm dev:flags set <key> on|off`, refused unless CARPAL_ENV=dev) with a test, recorded in both plans (OQ-09 allows minimal backend changes). Until then the PWA shows the flag-off states (GD-13).
doc_issues.status: resolved 2026-10-30 (P8.T0): backend `pnpm dev:flags list | set <key|community>… on|off` (tools/db/dev-flags.ts, refused unless CARPAL_ENV=dev, unit test; publishes feature_flag.changed so a running backend drops its cache at once). The PWA E2E (tests/e2e/community.spec.ts) runs it in beforeAll.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-SRCH-01 has mode tabs Showcases and Q&A, but search.run's showcases/qna modes rank providers (backend DI-48) and there is no showcase search operation.
doc_issues.action: P6: the Q&A tab calls questions.search (only when qna.enabled); the Showcases tab is hidden until a showcase search exists; listed in the P6 report.

doc_issues.issue: Organization slugs can change (≤ 2 per 30 days) and published organizations get a generated default slug ('<latin-name>-<12 hex>' or 'org-<12 hex>' for non-Latin names, backend S9b), but there is no slug history or redirect operation (backend DI-30): old /shop/<slug> links answer 404.
doc_issues.action: P5: profile pages 404 on unknown slugs (merged organizations still 301 through merged_into); sitemaps are regenerated from current slugs; ask the backend owner for a slug history read so old links can 301.
doc_issues.p5: Built as decided: unknown slugs 404; wrong part/showcase slugs (id known) move permanently to the canonical URL.

doc_issues.issue: The design system bundle has 21 icons and no slots for trailing chip icons or field prefixes; the screens need more (mobile/preview README 'Design-system notes for review' 1-5).
doc_issues.action: GD-11 amendment: port the mobile/preview kit.js additions; propose them to the design-system owner.

doc_issues.issue: ATT operations a web client calls — the anonymous grant, review_invitations.open, review submission, invitation acceptance, sign-up (SEC-MOB-3) — need CarPal-PoW from auth.pow_challenge on the web when strict mode is on (backend GD-06 enforces ATT only with CARPAL_STRICT_AUTH=1).
doc_issues.action: P2 adds a PoW solver (Web Worker for browser-initiated calls, server-side for the BFF's anonymous grant) behind a 'server asked' switch: it runs only when a call is refused for a missing proof or when strict mode is configured. Lite/dev never needs it.
doc_issues.note: P2: seams built — TokenClient PoW hook (after 403 ATTESTATION_REQUIRED, or up front with CARPAL_STRICT_AUTH=1) and the browser solver (Web Worker) used by the typed client for the ATT operations; unit-tested, not exercised live (lite never asks).

doc_issues.issue: P10.T5 planned the /l/ci check-in page 'for signed-in requester', but appointments.check_in_link is PUB LNK(ci): it works with the anonymous token too (backend S7: 'check-in by link needs an anonymous token like the other PUB link operations').
doc_issues.action: P10.T5 corrected (stage amendment): the page works for guests and signed-in users; LINK_EXPIRED 410 and INVALID_TRANSITION(outside_window) 409 states.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/40 types redirect_uri as Url, which is 'https:// only'; the backend rejects http://localhost redirect URIs (422 VALIDATION_FAILED /query/redirect_uri pattern). The plan's dev topology (GD-05) assumed http://localhost:3000.
doc_issues.action: GD-05 P2 amendment: register https://localhost:3000/bff/oauth/callback. P4 serves the PWA over https in development for the browser sign-in (OQ-10). P2 int tests drive the BFF directly with the https origin.

doc_issues.issue: auth.token and the /v1/auth/* sign-in operations are RL(auth.signin): 30 per 15 min per IP prefix (plus public.read 600/min per IP). The backend takes the client IP from the socket only, so behind the BFF every refresh, anonymous grant, code exchange and hosted-UI call of every user counts against the BFF host's one IP. In production this caps the whole site at about 30 sign-in-related calls per 15 minutes.
doc_issues.action: Tell the backend owner (noted in backend/dev_plan.json handoff_notes): the BFF needs a trusted forwarded client IP (e.g. a signed header accepted only from the BFF/mTLS) or confidential-client token requests exempt from the IP window. Until then the BFF keeps token calls to the minimum (lazy anonymous grants, single-flight refresh, no proactive refresh) and dev/test runs use CARPAL_RATE_LIMIT_SCALE=100.

doc_issues.issue: A cp-ssr token is an anonymous principal for the backend (acr anonymous, anonKey = HMAC(sub 'cp-ssr')), so all server rendering shares one public.read bucket (120/min, 3,000/day) and one search bucket (10/min anon). SEO pages (P5/P6) would hit that within minutes of real traffic.
doc_issues.action: Ask the backend owner for a cp-ssr bucket (or rate limiting cp-ssr per page host instead of per token). P5/P6 cache public reads on the server (short TTL) and measure the call count per page; record the result in their reports.
doc_issues.p5_measurement: Reads per page view, cached 60 s per key: provider 4, vendor 3 (one in the search bucket), part 2, showcase 2, landing 2 per chosen city (both search bucket), static 0; sitemaps about 30 searches + up to 190 reads per 6 h (P5 report).

doc_issues.issue: Docs/21 §2.2 and Docs/22 §2.2-2.3 assume an active (primary) vehicle shown in the vehicle context chip and the "Your garage" box, but the contract has no primary/active vehicle field on Vehicle or the user profile.
doc_issues.action: P3: the active vehicle is a per-browser choice (localStorage "cp:active-vehicle", default the first vehicle in use, "Any vehicle" allowed; useActiveVehicle()). Ask the backend owner for a preference field (OQ-12); noted in backend/dev_plan.json handoff_notes.
doc_issues.note: 2026-10-25 OQ-12 (user): keep the active vehicle per browser; no backend field. P4: the onboarding's first car becomes the browser's active vehicle.

doc_issues.issue: taxonomy.suggest (header typeahead) is RL(search), the same bucket as search.run — 10/min for guests — so typing competes with real searches; its types are capped at 5 (Set<TaxonomyType,5>).
doc_issues.action: P3: suggestions debounce 350 ms from 2 characters, cache per text, stop after a 429 until the server delay passes (free-text search still works), and ask for 5 types (symptom, service_task, part_category, vehicle_brand, vehicle_model). Ask the backend owner for a typeahead bucket; noted in backend/dev_plan.json.

doc_issues.issue: RegionConfig has no display currency unit and no time zone; the pilot designs show IRR in toman ("T" / "تومان") and times in Tehran time.
doc_issues.action: P3: CURRENCY_DISPLAY maps IRR → toman (÷ 10) and DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE = Asia/Tehran until the browser's zone is known (cp_tz cookie). Both should move into the region config if confirmed (OQ-11, OQ-13).
doc_issues.note: 2026-10-25 OQ-11/OQ-13 (user): prices are based in USD with a per-browser conversion to toman or rial at the visitor's own rate (no region field); the time zone is the browser's, else the deployment's CARPAL_PWA_DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE (Asia/Tehran). Built in P4 (GD-10 P4 amendment). shared/region-config still says currency IRR: the backend owner should decide whether amounts are stored in USD from now on (noted in backend/dev_plan.json).

doc_issues.issue: W-AUTH-01/S-AUTH-03 sign-up needs the Terms and Privacy Policy versions 'from config' and records marketing and AI-personalisation consents with the account, but config.client has no policy versions and auth.signup takes only terms_version/privacy_policy_version (no consents; consents.grant needs a signed-in user).
doc_issues.action: P4: CARPAL_PWA_TERMS_VERSION / CARPAL_PWA_PRIVACY_VERSION (env, default 2026-10) feed auth.signup and the policy_version of consent records; the optional boxes are kept in the tab's sessionStorage and granted after the first sign-in (consents.grant platform + me.preferences_update), by the onboarding. A separate id host (OQ-03) would lose them: ask the backend owner for policy versions in config.client and optional consents on auth.signup. The legal texts themselves wait for the legal review (OQ-15); the 'Read' dialogs say the text is being reviewed and name the version.

doc_issues.issue: C-ONB-03 'Your interests' saves topics and brands as feed preferences, but the contract has no feed-preference operation (follows.put takes organisations only), and the community feed flag is off in the seeds (DI-18).
doc_issues.action: P4: the step is not offered (W-ONB-01 shows 4 steps). P8 adds it when the feed is enabled, with 'Nearby shops to follow' through follows.put; ask the backend owner for a feed-preference operation for topics and brands.
doc_issues.note: P8: still no feed-preference operation, so the step is not added (it would save nothing). Shops to follow are on the home feed (Follow on nearby cards).

doc_issues.issue: C-ONB-01 decodes a typed VIN before saving ('decodes within 2 s; shows the result card'), but vehicles.vin_decode works on a saved vehicle only ({V}/{vehicle_id}/vin-decode) and vehicles.create needs brand, model and year. The lite decoder suggests only the model year; full mode answers 503 until a regional decoder exists.
doc_issues.action: P4: the car is chosen from the list with an optional VIN; after saving, the decoder's suggestions are offered ('This VIN suggests 2011; you entered 2012' → Use / Keep, other fields → 'Add these details', applied with vehicles.update); 503 shows nothing. A pre-save decode needs a backend operation (e.g. vehicles.vin_decode_preview).

doc_issues.issue: S-AUTH-09 locked/suspended/deactivated states and S-AUTH-02 'remaining attempts' / 'Number not registered → Sign up with this number' have no auth-host signal: suspended accounts get the same 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS (and no codes), locks are 429 RATE_LIMITED on the auth.signin/auth.otp buckets, attempt counts are not disclosed, and an unknown number cannot be told apart (SEC-AU-11).
doc_issues.action: P4: the timed lock is the 429 with its countdown (Retry-After, else 15 min) plus Reset password; messages stay enumeration-safe ('If … belongs to a CarPal account, we sent it a code'); suspended, deactivated, the appeal form and the data-export link are not shown at sign-in. Ask the backend owner whether a suspended account should learn its state after a correct password (e.g. 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED only after a valid credential).

doc_issues.issue: auth.authorize resumes a completed interaction only when prompt is not 'login' (backend auth-ops AuthorizeHandler), so a step-up or 'Switch account' authorize request re-sent unchanged starts a new interaction forever. acr_values is stored on the interaction but not enforced; an account without a second factor completes at aal1 (BA-11).
doc_issues.action: P4: the hosted sign-in re-requests the authorize URL without prompt (resumeUrl); the BFF callback accepts a step-up when the authentication is fresh and, for aal3, at the asked level. Verified against the live backend (hosted-signin.int.test.ts). Tell the backend owner the resume contract (documented in backend/dev_plan.json).

doc_issues.issue: Docs/21 S-AUTH-03 allows sign-up with a mobile number instead of an email, S-AUTH-02 offers 'Use password' with a phone, and S-AUTH-08 resets by phone code; the contract requires an email on auth.signup, auth.signin_password takes an email only, and auth.password_reset_start sends an email link only.
doc_issues.action: P4: email is required at sign-up (mobile number optional, verification can switch to a text); 'Use password' is disabled for phone numbers with a hint; reset is by email link (/l/pr).

doc_issues.issue: P2 design: the BFF creates a pre-session lazily on /bff/csrf, /bff/login and the first /api/v1 call. Two such requests of one page running at the same time without a cookie create two sessions; the later Set-Cookie wins and the other's intents and pending sign-ins are lost (seen in the P4 E2E: the hosted sign-in lost its context line).
doc_issues.action: P4: the browser creates the pre-session through one shared /bff/csrf before any api-host call (GD-08 P4 amendment). When the BFF moves to backend/api-gateway (NI-08), consider a server-side remedy too (e.g. the forwarder answering without creating a session for safe calls, or merging pre-sessions).

doc_issues.issue: public.org_get, public.inventory_get and showcases.get answer 404 for suspended, merged, unpublished and removed records alike; PublicOrgProfile has no merged_into. Docs/22 wants a 301 for merged duplicates, a 200 + noindex "not currently available" page for suspended businesses and a "no longer available" page (410 for crawlers; 200 + noindex per OQ-14) for removed parts and showcases.
doc_issues.action: P5 serves 404 + noindex for all of them and keeps the 410 branch (SystemPage suspended / gone with 200 + noindex) ready. Asked the backend owner (backend/dev_plan.json handoff pwa P5) for a 410 GONE or a tombstone read and a merged_into slug.

doc_issues.issue: No public listing read for sitemaps (every published organization, item and showcase with slug and update time).
doc_issues.action: P5 builds sitemaps from search.run per pilot city, public.org_portfolio and public.org_inventory_search under a call budget, cached 6 h (costs the cp-ssr search bucket, DI-26). Asked the backend owner for a paged public sitemap feed.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 elements without a public field: the AI review-theme summary (W-PUB-02 Overview), the stock "last updated" time and AI alternatives (W-PUB-08), the customer-consent marker of a showcase (W-PUB-05), a fitment confidence per covered brand/model (W-PUB-03).
doc_issues.action: Not shown in P5; listed for the backend owner.

doc_issues.issue: P2 allowlist rule (a) excluded every route with an {org_id} path parameter, so consumer routes that only name an organization as their target were refused at the BFF: follows.put/delete, favorites.put/delete and the /v1/public/orgs/{org_id}/… reads (reviews, portfolio, inventory search, availability, posts). Found by the P5 Follow round trip.
doc_issues.action: Fixed in P5: the forwarder excludes the organization scope /v1/orgs/{org_id}/… (except the DRV fleet routes) instead (GD-08 P5 amendment); 9 more routes admitted (170 consumer + 18 fleet driver).

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 open point 7: should the shop phone be public or shown only after sign-in? The Call button "reveals the number on click".
doc_issues.action: P5 keeps the number out of the page HTML and the JSON-LD (anti-scraping) and loads it with public.org_get through the BFF on click (guests too). Product decision still open.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-SRCH-01 / S-SHARED-03: every filter option shows a result count and the filters-too-narrow state names the filter that removed most results; SearchResponse has no counts.
doc_issues.action: P6 shows counts only when the session's whole result list is loaded and the card has the field; the empty state offers Remove filter: … for each active filter. Asked the backend owner for facet counts on search.run/refine.
doc_issues.resolution: Contract 1.1.0 (Docs/40, 2026-10-26, BA-36): SearchRequest.facets and the refine facets flag → SearchResponse.facets (SearchFacets: per-option counts with selected, result_count, capped, and without_filter for each active filter). Backend S10 serves it; P14.T2 replaces the complete-list counting and names the filter with the largest count_without in the filters-too-narrow state.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/21 C-SEARCH-01 sort "Soonest available"; SearchRequest.sort is best_match | distance | rating.
doc_issues.action: Not offered; the Availability filter (available_within_days) is there. Backend owner asked for a soonest sort.
doc_issues.resolution: Contract 1.1.0 (BA-36): SearchSort adds 'soonest' (providers by next_available_slot; providers without a slot, vendors and parts after in best-match order; inactive last) and ResultCard.next_available_slot is defined (earliest open slot in 30 days, never in the past; the backend returned null until S10). Backend S10 serves it; P14.T3 adds the sort option (URL sort=soonest) and the slot on cards.

doc_issues.issue: MapPin has organization_id, name and ranks but no slug or card fields, so a pin alone cannot open the profile (View) or its request step for every business in view.
doc_issues.action: P6 runs a search session for the same area (map_center) and joins the pins to its result cards; pins outside that list have no View. Asked for slug (and roles/verified) on MapPin.
doc_issues.resolution: Contract 1.1.0 (BA-36): MapPin gains slug, organization_type, verified, review_count and result_id (the organization's result in search_session_id). Backend S10 serves it; P14.T4 gives every pin View and Request and builds W-MAP-01's places from the pins.

doc_issues.issue: S-SHARED-02 quick chip Open now on the map; map.pins ignores filters.open_now (and available_within_days).
doc_issues.action: Open now filters pins and list on the client by MapPin.open_now.
doc_issues.resolution: Contract 1.1.0 (BA-36): map.pins judges open_now per location and available_within_days per organization in matches_filters; MapQuery.only_matching leaves non-matching pins out before clustering; MapResponse.counts gives matching/others. Backend S10 serves it; P14.T4 moves Open now to the server (only_matching) so cluster counts are right, and Advanced search reads the counts.

doc_issues.issue: search.page needs a cursor, so the first page of a session cannot be read again (reload, shared link); sessions are caller-bound anyway.
doc_issues.action: P6 keeps the response in the tab and re-runs the request stored for the session (sessionStorage) after a reload; a shared link searches from its enumerated filters only. A first-page read (search.page without cursor) would let reloads keep the session.
doc_issues.resolution: Contract 1.1.0 (BA-36): new operation search.session_get (GET /v1/search/{session_id}?limit, readable for 24 hours, the same SearchResponse with the stored facets; no new ranking, no analytics event) and search.page takes limit. Backend S10 serves it; P14.T5 reads the session on reload and Back and keeps the stored request only as the fallback for a 404.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/21 C-GARAGE-05 "Provider: search CarPal providers, or type a name for a shop not on CarPal": ServiceRecordWrite has no free-text shop name, and the consumer API has no organization lookup besides search.run (which makes a ranked, logged session).
doc_issues.action: P7: the Shop picker offers the CarPal shops of this car’s history; a typed shop name is kept as the description’s first line ("Shop: …"). Ask the backend owner for ServiceRecordWrite.provider_name (Str<1,120>) and a light organization lookup for pickers (name prefix → OrgSummary).

doc_issues.issue: Docs/21 C-GARAGE-09 "Sold asks for an optional sale date": StatusChange is { status, reason? } and VehicleStatusHistory keeps changed_at only.
doc_issues.action: P7: no sale date is asked. Ask the backend owner for StatusChange.effective_date (Date ≤ today) if the buyer-facing export should show it.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 §7 and Docs/56 §9: reactions are Helpful / Great work / Thanks (hover over Helpful shows the three). The contract has two types (reactions.put reaction_type helpful | like; backend rules.ts: helpful on reviews, answers and posts, like on posts, comments and portfolio items).
doc_issues.action: P8: Helpful = helpful; Great work = like on showcases and posts; Thanks = like on comments. No three-way picker. Ask product/backend whether a third type is wanted (OQ-21).

doc_issues.issue: Community reads carry no viewer context: PublicQuestion, PublicAnswer and Comment name the author by display name only (no author id or is_mine), no read says whether the caller already reacted, the author's own held (pending) items carry no moderation_status (questions.get / comments.list return them like approved ones), Comment has no organization (no Shop badge for provider replies), and there is no consumer read of one's own reports (S-SHARED-08 'follow the status in C-PROF-06') or of one's own questions/answers/comments (My Activity).
doc_issues.action: P8: src/features/community/memory.ts remembers per user and browser the ids posted here, the reactions given here and the author name the backend used; looksMine() = posted here or the same display name — it only decides which buttons show (Accept, Delete, Edit/Close); the server refuses the rest (404). 'Being reviewed' = mine + the backend's contact-data rule (heldForReview, a copy of rules.ts autoModeration with a drift test) + absent from the public read. Ask the backend owner for a viewer block on PublicQuestion/PublicAnswer/Comment ({ is_author, reactions: [type] }), moderation_status on the author's own items, Comment.organization (PublicOrgCard | null) and reports.mine_list / questions.mine_list (or a My Activity read).

doc_issues.issue: Q&A gaps against Docs/22 W-QA-01 / W-PUB-06: questions.search has no sort (newest first only) and the hub has no 'top answerers this month' read; PublicQuestion carries taxonomy labels, not node ids (the car and category chips cannot link to filtered lists; related questions cannot be searched by category); there is no 'Follow question' operation; AnswerWrite.as_organization_id needs the caller's memberships, which the consumer PWA does not read.
doc_issues.action: P8: newest first ('Newest questions first' note); related questions = questions.search on the two longest title words (src/server/ssr/community.ts searchWords); Follow question and top answerers not offered; answers are always personal (business members answer from the portal later). Ask the backend owner for sort (newest | most_answered | unanswered_first), node ids next to the labels on PublicQuestion, questions.follow / unfollow, and a top-answerers read.

doc_issues.issue: Discover feed details: followed_update cards carry organization_id only (no PublicOrgCard, no slug, no public post page — posts.public_list is per organization); feed.discover is not behind a flag while posts.public_list is behind community.feed.enabled; there is no personalisation setting or signal for Docs/22's 'personalization off' state; reminders and documents for 'Needs your attention' need one read per car.
doc_issues.action: P8: update cards are named through follows.list (the user follows them) and link to the business profile; followed_update cards are hidden while community.feed.enabled is off, the rest of Discover always shows; no personalisation-off note; attention cards read the active car only. Ask the backend owner for a PublicOrgCard on followed_update cards.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-PUB-06 SEO: 'only questions with at least one answer are indexed'; the P8 task says 'indexed only when answered' and its E2E expects the page to become indexable when Sara accepts.
doc_issues.action: P8: indexed (robots index + QAPage JSON-LD) only when status = answered (an accepted answer); open questions with answers stay noindex. Decision recorded as OQ-20.
doc_issues.resolution: 2026-10-30: OQ-20 answered (user accepted the default): indexed only with an accepted answer, as built in P8.

doc_issues.issue: The community.followed_update notification renders '{organization_name} posted an update' in the backend's email/push template, but the routed in-app params carry only post_type (routing.ts community.post.published), and the notification has organization_context_id null and reference {post, id} — no organization id, so the PWA can neither name the shop nor open its profile (there is no public post page either, DI-52).
doc_issues.action: P9: the in-app text says 'A shop you follow posted an update' and opens Saved & Following. Ask the backend owner to add organization_name and organization_id (or slug) to the params.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/21 C-PROF-01..09 elements without a contract field or operation: profile photo and country (Me has neither), Deactivate account, the review-invitation channel choice (in-app / email), the per-feature AI switches (Help Me personalised vs session only, personalised matching, writing help, 'Show why'), quiet hours, SMS notifications, help articles / Report a problem / Contact support (OQ-18), the business name of an active share (ConsentRecord has granted_to_id and scope ids only).
doc_issues.action: P9: not offered (W-SET-01 deviations); the shares show their type and scope. Ask the backend owner whether any of them belong in the MVP.

doc_issues.issue: Backend session details seen in P9: (1) AAL2 for an account without a second factor is decided per session at sign-in (session.mfaEnrolled), so the session that enrols the first factor keeps AAL2 for the rest of its 10-minute fresh-sign-in window; (2) me.sessions_list returns device_label = the client id ('cp-web-consumer') for web sessions, not a browser/OS label.
doc_issues.action: P9: (1) recorded, harmless (the enrolment itself needed the fresh sign-in); (2) the table shows "A browser (CarPal on the web)" when device_label equals the client id. Ask the backend owner for a user-agent based label.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/21 §6 notification types with no backend route (routing.ts): 'Answer to your question' (no qna event is routed), 'Data export ready' (DSR completion notifies nobody), 'Request received by shop' to the requester (appointment.requested notifies the provider only), 'Monthly mileage reminder' and 'Document expiring' (only as maintenance reminders, if such reminders exist). 'Showcase consent request' and emailed review invitations are email/SMS only by design (BA-18).
doc_issues.action: P9: the deep-link table covers every type the backend sends; the rest is listed here for the backend owner.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-HELP-01 / Docs/55 C-HELP-04: clarifying questions offer answer chips selectable with the number keys 1-5; TriageSession.next_question is free text (Text<500>) without options, and the turns keep only text.
doc_issues.action: P10: an answer field plus Not sure / Skip (keys 1/2). Ask the backend owner for TriageSession.next_question_options (List<Str<1,80>,5>, optional) so the web and mobile can show chips.

doc_issues.issue: Platform-wide consents: the PWA granted location_usage, marketing and ai_personalization with granted_to {type: platform} (P4 onboarding, P6 Near me, P9 settings), but the backend checks them without a grantee (search.run user_position, notification preferences for marketing), and identity.has_consent with a null grantee matches only records without a grantee. Signed-in Near me therefore always answered 403 LOCATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED (found by the P10 E2E), and the marketing preference would be refused.
doc_issues.action: Fixed in P10 on the PWA side: these consents are granted without granted_to (as the backend's own tests grant them). Ask the backend owner to decide the rule: either the checks pass grantee platform (has_consent then accepts both forms) or consents.grant refuses granted_to platform for platform-wide types. Dev consents granted before P10 carry the platform grantee and stay ineffective.

doc_issues.issue: The request step needs the shop's name, locations, time zone and service modes, but the only public read is public.org_get by slug; links and intents name the organization by id.
doc_issues.action: P10: request links carry shop=<slug>; without one the step shows "This shop" with in-shop service. Ask for public.org_get by id (or an OrgSummary with service_modes and locations) if links without slugs remain.

doc_issues.issue: share_history (the appointment-scoped vehicle_data_sharing + service_history_sharing consents) can only be set by appointments.create: AppointmentUpdate has no share_history, triage.complete draft_appointment_with makes a draft without it, and drafts cannot be deleted (only cancelled, so a replaced preview draft shows in Cancelled; drafts list in the Requested group).
doc_issues.action: P10: the preview draft is appointments.create submit=false; when the consent (or car, shop, source) changes it is cancelled with reason "replaced" and made again. Ask for AppointmentUpdate.share_history (or a draft delete) so replaced drafts do not pile up.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/22 W-HELP-01 route /help/<session-id>/<step> and "Save and exit": there is no read of one's own triage sessions (no triage.mine_list), so an open case cannot be listed or resumed on another device, and requests without triage have no server session at all.
doc_issues.action: P10: the URL names the browser's case (which holds the triage session id); "Continue your case" lists this browser's open cases. Ask for triage.mine_list (open sessions with vehicle and first turn) if cross-device resume is wanted.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/55 C-HELP-05 "Request towing if available" and the prototype's "Call emergency services": the contract has no towing providers or offers (only the service system "Roadside assistance and towing") and the region config has no emergency numbers.
doc_issues.action: P10: not offered; Find urgent help shows the shops that can see the user soonest. Ask for region.emergency_numbers and a towing search preset if wanted.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/55 C-HELP-08 "Request ID/reference" (prototype "Reference #1042"): Appointment has no short reference.
doc_issues.action: P10: "#" + the last 6 hex digits of the id (random in UUIDv7). Ask for Appointment.reference if shops should quote it by phone.

doc_issues.issue: Docs/21 C-APP-02 Call / Message / Report a problem: the requester's Appointment carries no provider phone, and reports.create has no appointment target (disputes.create covers appointments but is a different flow).
doc_issues.action: P10: Call loads the public profile's number (CallButton) when the slug is known; Message = the notes thread; no Report a problem on appointments (P11/P13 may add the dispute flow).

doc_issues.issue: The author's Review (reviews.mine_list/get) names its subject by subject_organization_id only — no name, slug or OrgSummary — and public.org_get reads by slug, so My Activity cannot name or link the shop of a review written on another device (or link it to its profile).
doc_issues.action: P11: names come from this browser's memory of reviews written here (localStorage cp:review-orgs) and from the user's past appointments and stock inquiries; otherwise "A shop" / "A parts seller" without a link (and without Edit, which needs the slug). Ask the backend owner for Review.subject: OrgSummary (as ReviewInvitation has).

doc_issues.issue: W-REV-02 / C-REV-03 elements without contract support: ConsentRequestView has no caption, tags or redaction areas (only purpose_i18n_key and preview_media_urls), consents.request_respond takes only grant | decline, so "Ask for more blurring" with marked rectangles cannot reach the shop; preview_media_urls was always [] (fixed in the backend in P11, in contract).
doc_issues.action: P11: the page shows the exact photos, where they appear and the purpose; Ask for more blurring explains that marks cannot be sent and declines (the shop may send a new request). Ask for ConsentRequestView.caption/tags and a respond decision 'needs_changes' with areas + note.

doc_issues.issue: There is no consumer read of pending consent requests (no consents.requests_mine), and showcase consent requests are email-only by design (BA-18), so C-REV-03's Needs-your-attention card on Home and the C-PROF-02 entry cannot exist on the web.
doc_issues.action: P11: /l/cn from the email only; Home and the rail show review invitations (review_invitations.mine_list) but no consent requests. Ask for a mine-list of pending consent requests if the attention card is wanted.

doc_issues.issue: C-REV-01 "Live helper (AI)" nudges and "AI-suggested tags" have no consumer operation (ai.* review operations are business-side), and the privacy check's "full name" detection has no reliable rule.
doc_issues.action: P11: no AI nudges; tags are the review_tag nodes for the subject, with the ones taxonomy.suggest finds in the text marked Suggested (only selected ones are sent); the privacy check detects plates, phone numbers, emails and links (heuristics) and the display note says the full name is never shown.

doc_issues.issue: Appeal of a rejected or removed review: the author has no moderation_action id (the dispute type moderation_appeal targets one), and disputes on a review accept fake_review | inaccurate_review | mediation_request only (backend dispute-ops TYPES_BY_TARGET).
doc_issues.action: P11: Appeal = disputes.create {target: review, dispute_type: mediation_request, reason}; disputes.mine_list shows its status on the review, withdrawable while open. Ask whether the author's appeal should be moderation_appeal on the review itself.

backend_alignment.purpose: Facts from the finished backend (backend/dev_plan.json global_decisions, doc_issues, deviations_log, stage reports, next_iteration; checked against the code and Docs/40 where noted) that change what the PWA stages must do. Each item names the stages it affects; stage amendments point back here. Read the items listed in a stage's amendments before starting it.
sources: git diff of Docs/40 since the plan commit 52e7b4f (vehicle transfers, Problem members, SEC-UP-2, SEC-AZ-7, DRV on fleet reads, CarPal-Reason, versions on staff types)

backend code: libs/config/config.ts, libs/auth, modules/identity/application/auth-ops.ts + auth-server.ts, modules/notification/application/dispatcher.ts, modules/analytics/domain/events.ts, libs/infra/lite/sinks.ts, Docs/43 flag seeds

items.fact: Backend scratch build done: 405/406 operations served; auth.social_start answers 501 by decision (post-MVP, PM-01).
items.pwa_impact: No stage waits on a backend stage any more; the 'build against the contract with 501 states' fallback of how_to_use applies only to auth.social_start. Read backend/dev_plan.json next_iteration before a stage whose area appears there (NI-01 strict auth, NI-03 fleet roles, NI-08 BFFs).

items.fact: AI runs through a deterministic stub in dev (CARPAL_MCP_MODE=stub default) and is 'unavailable' by default in staging/prod until the real MCP gateway exists (backend GD-35, NI-09). triage.start/reply answer 503 AI_UNAVAILABLE with Problem.safety (SafetyBlock & do_not_drive) and Problem.fallback_path.
items.pwa_impact: Every AI screen (garage suggestions and history insights, Help Me) must be complete in the AI-off state; Help Me shows the server safety block from the 503 body and continues with the category picker and search (fallback_path). Add an E2E run with the backend started with CARPAL_MCP_MODE=unavailable.

items.fact: Problem gained optional members requirements, consent_type, entitlement_key (S4) and safety, fallback_path, vin_transfer_available (S9a).
items.pwa_impact: GD-09 amendment (1): the typed ApiProblem exposes them; screens branch on them instead of parsing detail text.

items.fact: One owner per VIN (backend GD-33): vehicles.create/update with a VIN that another owner has → 409 DUPLICATE at /vin with vin_transfer_available true. New operations vehicles.transfer_request {vin, message?} (USR, IDEM, ENT(max_vehicles); 422 REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND when no vehicle has the VIN, 409 DUPLICATE when already owned or asked), vehicles.transfers_list (direction incoming|outgoing, status), vehicles.transfer_decide {decision accept|reject} (owner, IDEM, AUD), vehicles.transfer_cancel (buyer). Requests expire after 14 days; the current owner is never disclosed to the buyer; acceptance moves the vehicle with its records and media to the buyer. Vehicle.duplicate_vin_warning is always false. Events vehicle.transfer.requested/decided and vehicle.transferred.
items.pwa_impact: W-GAR-03 and the W-ONB-01 first-car step add the 'Did you buy this car?' flow on the 409 (keep the entered data; message field; pending state with Cancel). W-GAR-01 gets an 'Ownership requests' block (incoming: Accept/Reject with a clear warning of what moves; outgoing: status, expiry, Cancel) and a Needs-your-attention card. P9 maps the transfer notifications to these views. Never render duplicate_vin_warning.

items.fact: Docs/40 SEC-UP-2 changed (backend GD-32): image/heic is refused at media.upload_init (422) — clients convert HEIC to JPEG first; video/mp4 at most 15 s; PDFs never public and never behind an anonymous link. Allowed: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp (≤ 20 MB, ≤ 40 MP), video/mp4 (≤ 100 MB, ≤ 15 s), application/pdf (documents, ≤ 20 MB), text/csv (imports).
items.pwa_impact: P7.T2: HEIC/HEIF conversion to JPEG in the browser is required (lazy-loaded WASM decoder in a worker; record the library); if it fails, say so and ask for a JPEG. Check video duration from the file's metadata before upload_init. PDFs only in private views through 5-minute signed URLs; never attach PDFs to public content (questions, answers, comments).

items.fact: Lite media facts: W6 processes uploads asynchronously; media.get answers 404 while an asset is pending_upload (backend DI-25); public media (posts, questions, showcases, portfolio) stay private until moderation approves them (S8 intake), author avatars are null; videos are never publicly servable in lite (no transcoding); signed URLs in lite point at the storage listener over http (CARPAL_STORAGE_URL, :8083; backend DI-26) — production uses media.carpal-usercontent.app; the storage PUT must use UploadTicket.url exactly as given (backend S9c).
items.pwa_impact: CSP img-src/media-src/connect-src include the storage origin from env in dev and the media host in prod (GD-15). Public pages render fixed-size placeholders when an image is missing. The upload kit polls media.get/jobs.get with Poll-After and treats 404 right after upload_init as 'not ready'.

items.fact: Re-verified 2026-10-25: the backend sends no Access-Control-* headers anywhere (storage listener included).
items.pwa_impact: DI-08 and P7.T1 stay as planned (CORS on the storage listener for configured web origins, PUT + OPTIONS only, no credentials).

items.fact: Re-verified 2026-10-25: the auth host does not check Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site or CSRF on /v1/auth/*.
items.pwa_impact: DI-09 stays; the hosted UI sends the headers anyway.

items.fact: WebAuthn implemented (backend GD-31, @simplewebauthn/server 14.0.3): passkey sign-in = auth.webauthn_options {interaction_id, purpose: signin} + auth.mfa_verify {method: webauthn, assertion} without a first factor; AuthNext.mfa_methods may list webauthn; purpose step_up for re-authentication. Enrolment: me.webauthn_register_options {label} (USR AAL2) returns creation options; the pending method's id comes from me.mfa_list; me.mfa_confirm activates it. Synced passkeys give aal2, device-bound aal3. RP ID default carpal.app, origins from CARPAL_WEBAUTHN_ORIGINS.
items.pwa_impact: P4.T4: passkeys are no longer hidden — 'Sign in with a passkey' on the identifier step and webauthn as an MFA method. P9.T2: passkey enrolment and removal in Sign-in & security. Use @simplewebauthn/browser at the major matching the server (record the version). Dev env per GD-05 amendment (RP ID localhost).

items.fact: Google/Apple sign-in is post-MVP (backend OQ-06, PM-01); auth.social_start answers 501.
items.pwa_impact: No social buttons in the MVP hosted UI (P4 out_of_scope unchanged).

items.fact: AAL2 for accounts without a second factor is satisfied by a sign-in within the last 10 minutes (backend DI-11); auth.authorize accepts acr_values (aal1|aal2|aal3) and prompt (login|none); without prompt=login an existing auth session is reused.
items.pwa_impact: Step-up = /bff/login?step_up=aal2 → /oauth/authorize with acr_values=aal2 and prompt=login, then the original action replays (GD-06 intent). The 401 STEP_UP_REQUIRED from the API carries acr_values and max_age=600 (SEC-AU-10).

items.fact: Hosted sign-in completion re-requests /oauth/authorize (cookie-bound interaction); interaction errors are 410 LINK_EXPIRED (backend DI-15). /oauth/token errors are RFC 6749 JSON; the auth server emits invalid_grant, invalid_dpop_proof, use_dpop_nonce, invalid_client, invalid_request, invalid_scope, unauthorized_client, unsupported_grant_type (backend S9c).
items.pwa_impact: GD-05 amendment. The BFF maps invalid_grant on refresh to 'session ended' (sign in again), everything else to a generic sign-in error with the request id.

items.fact: Auth form details from backend S3: a breached or trivial password is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED with code 'pattern' at /password or /new_password (DI-13); auth.email_verify answers 409 DUPLICATE when the new address was taken meanwhile (DI-16); SMS to a country code outside the region list is 422 VALIDATION_FAILED at /phone or /destination with code 'enum'; sign-up, sign-in, OTP and reset start have a fixed minimum latency of about 400 ms (SEC-AU-11); the breached-password list is small in lite.
items.pwa_impact: Localized messages for each case ('Choose a less common password', 'This email is now used by another account', 'We can't send texts to this country yet'); spinners never time out before 10 s; enumeration-safe copy kept.

items.fact: onboarding.update is ETAG but creates a missing flow when If-Match is "v1" (backend DI-14).
items.pwa_impact: GD-09 amendment (2); onboarding saves send If-Match "v1" for the first save of a flow.

items.fact: ETags come in the ETag header; questions have no version in the body (backend DI-47); reactions bump the version of posts and answers (S6); every update bumps version (core.tg_touch).
items.pwa_impact: GD-09 amendment (2) and (5).

items.fact: search.run: guests may not send vehicle_id or location mode user_position (401 UNAUTHENTICATED); user_position needs a signed-in user with the location_usage consent (403 LOCATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED otherwise). search.page takes only a cursor and returns 20 results per page (backend DI-46); cursors are bound to caller and session (400 CURSOR_MISMATCH). search_mode showcases/qna rank providers (DI-48); issue_id is used only by Help Me matches; available_within_days keeps only providers with an indexed next open slot (providers without an online calendar drop out); default radius 50 km, Discover feed 25 km (backend OQ-14 proposals). feed.discover takes { location, vehicle_id?, cursor?, limit? } only.
items.pwa_impact: Guests send brand/model/series/year as filters and chosen_city or map_center locations; 'Near me' for guests asks them to pick a city or sign in. The availability filter explains that providers without online booking are hidden. Q&A tab per DI-19. Feed tabs per DI-07: only the Discover stream exists.

items.fact: Community: automatic pre-moderation (backend GD-22): posts, comments, questions and answers whose text contains a link, an email address or a phone number (also in Persian/Arabic digits) stay pending; edits are moderated again (a published post with a held edit goes back to draft). Deleting an accepted answer is 409 INVALID_TRANSITION (DI-51). reports.create is implemented; a second open report on the same target is 409 DUPLICATE (open_report_same_target). Flags per DI-18.
items.pwa_impact: Composer and answer box warn before sending when the text contains a link, email or phone ('Posts with contact details are checked by our team first'); after sending, held content shows 'Being reviewed'. Delete is hidden for an accepted answer. Report modal: 'You already reported this' on 409. P8.T6 no longer needs a 501 state.

items.fact: Notifications (backend GD-24, S6-S8): personal notifications go to every token of the user including platform web; business notifications only to web tokens (DI-16); a push token registered by another account is 409 DUPLICATE (backend DI-52); in-app notifications carry template_key + template_params and the client renders the text from its dictionary; secret-bearing messages (verification links and codes, invitations, consent links, ci check-in links, review invitation codes) are email/SMS only, never notifications; extra event types in use: system_announcement (fleet approval decisions, security alerts), moderation_update (moderation outcomes, verification, location corrections), moderation_alert (staff).
items.pwa_impact: P9.T1: the dictionary gets an EN/FA entry for every consumer template_key in backend/modules/notification/domain/templates.ts and routing.ts (drift test like GD-17's); unknown keys fall back to a generic line with the reference link. P12.T3: revoke the push token on logout (push_tokens.revoke) and on account switch; on 409 tell the user that this browser is linked to another account.

items.fact: Appointments (backend S7): the open-request caps (3 open per provider, 10 open in total, 7-day cooldown after a no-show at that provider) answer 429 RATE_LIMITED with retry-after 3600 (DI-55); a location without availability rules has no slots (public.availability returns none) but can still confirm requests (DI-56); slots are computed per request; an appointment created from an issue marks the issue scheduled when sent; the ci check-in link is mailed at confirmation and appointments.check_in_link is PUB LNK(ci) (DI-23); Appointment.requester_contact is only the verified email/phone of the preferred channel (DI-57); share_history creates the service_history_sharing consent for personal vehicles.
items.pwa_impact: The request step explains the caps in one message (the 429 does not say which cap) and never auto-retries (GD-09 amendment 3); 'Request anyway' with preferred windows when no slots; /l/ci works without sign-in.

items.fact: Analytics registry = backend CLIENT_EVENTS (see GD-17 amendment); events.ingest platform 'web_pwa'; ≤ 50 events per request; occurred_at within 5 min in the future and 7 days back.
items.pwa_impact: GD-17 amendment; the queue stamps occurred_at at capture time and drops events older than 7 days.

items.fact: Reviews (backend S7/S8): Path 1 reviews with links/emails/phones are held (pending_moderation, 'Being checked'); Path 2 reviews publish only after the business answer or the 7-day no_response rule plus the CarPal reviewer decision; one review without a visit per subject (eligibility already_reviewed); velocity limit 5 reviews per author per 24 h (REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED); review_invitations.open is ATT (DI-22); LNK operations answer 403 LINK_RECIPIENT_MISMATCH to another signed-in user and 410 LINK_EXPIRED/LINK_USED otherwise (the distinction is accepted as RCP-04).
items.pwa_impact: My Activity shows the real statuses; the mismatch state says 'This link was sent to another account — sign out and open it again'.

items.fact: Fleet drivers (backend GD-20, GD-38, DI-71): DRV routes are the 18 {flt} operations listed in the GD-08 amendment plus triage.start (USR | ORG(F*) DRV on /v1/me/triage-sessions); a driver sees fleet media only when they uploaded it or it is attached to a record of an assigned vehicle; never fleet AI insights or suggestions; driver issue reports start the fleet approval workflow (fleet_approval_status pending); drivers report issues only (backend OQ-15 default). The fleet role model (OQ-18, RCP-03) may still change who is limited to linked vehicles.
items.pwa_impact: GD-08 amendment. P12.T4 reads backend OQ-18/NI-03 first and builds only the assigned-vehicle views, issue reporting with photos and mileage, and read-only appointment status.

items.fact: backend/dev_plan.json next_iteration NI-08 plans 'consumer, portal and admin BFFs (api-gateway/, WP19/WP20)'.
items.pwa_impact: The consumer BFF is built once, in pwa/src/server/bff/ (GD-03), framework-free so it can move to backend/api-gateway/ unchanged. A note was added to backend NI-08 on 2026-10-25 so the backend reuses or moves it instead of writing a second one; NI-08 keeps the portal and admin BFFs.

items.fact: shared/api-contracts/openapi.yaml exists (generated and checked by the backend, GD-37); the Json<…> shapes are written down as OpenAPI components (DI-50 resolved).
items.pwa_impact: GD-04 amendment.

items.fact: `pnpm dev` uses the real rate-limit buckets (CARPAL_RATE_LIMIT_SCALE default 1; backend tests use ×1000) and the auth buckets are small; mails, SMS and pushes go to backend/.data/outbox-mail.jsonl, outbox-sms.jsonl and outbox-push.jsonl.
items.pwa_impact: The E2E README documents starting the backend with CARPAL_RATE_LIMIT_SCALE=100 for test runs (dev only); the outbox reader reads those three files.

items.fact: Strict mode later (backend NI-01): private_key_jwt over mTLS for cp-web-consumer and cp-ssr at /oauth/token, DPoP nonces, ATT/PoW on the anonymous grant.
items.pwa_impact: GD-07 amendment: pluggable client authentication and PoW hook; nothing strict is built in P2 beyond the seams and unit tests for them.

items.fact: Default slugs and slug changes without history (backend S9b, DI-30).
HoursSpec day_of_week 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday (JavaScript getDay; backend DI-29); 'open now' is computed by the server with CarPal-Timezone.
items.pwa_impact: Opening-hours tables start on Saturday for fa / the ir-pilot region and on the locale's first weekday otherwise, mapping indices by the 0 = Sunday rule; send CarPal-Timezone on every call (GD-07).

items.fact: Field rules enforced by the backend beyond the schema: IssueWrite.description at least 10 characters (DI-39, 422 too_short); vehicles.vin_reveal answers 404 for a vehicle without VIN (DI-42); VIN fields are upper-cased and Persian/Arabic digits normalized before the pattern check (x-vin), the ISO 3779 check digit is enforced only for WMI 1-5 and L (DI-37), invalid → 422 VIN_INVALID; Vehicle.data_sharing exists for fleet vehicles only (GD-34).
items.pwa_impact: Client validation mirrors these (no check-digit check for other WMIs); Reveal VIN only when vin_present; consumer vehicle forms never send data_sharing.

items.fact: DSR (backend GD-29): the export is one CSV in long format (section, record_id, field, value) downloaded through dsr.export_download; deletion anonymizes the account, removes vehicles, media, notifications and unpublished reviews, and keeps published reviews under 'former member'.
items.pwa_impact: Data & account copy describes exactly this; the download explains the CSV format.

items.fact: Consents are checked per scope type (vehicle, appointment, media_asset, portfolio_item, stock_inquiry); a vendor's inquiry vehicle snapshot is null while the vendor_fitment_context consent is missing (DI-44); consent withdrawal takes effect on the next request (SEC-AZ-8).
items.pwa_impact: Consent rows show their effect immediately; the inquiry form explains what the vendor sees with and without sharing.

items.fact: The taxonomy version is an opaque fingerprint string ('t<base36 ms>-<base36 rows>'), not semver; config.client reports the same value; the catalog can change at any time (refresh every 30 s on the server).
items.pwa_impact: Taxonomy caches compare versions for equality only.

items.fact: The lite search index is in memory per backend process, rebuilt at backend start, and catalog edits reach it through a one-minute sweep (backend GD-23, DI-45).
items.pwa_impact: E2E tests that create providers, vendors or items poll search for up to about 90 s before asserting; a backend restart empties nothing permanent but takes a rebuild.

items.fact: Moderation is staff work on admin-api (aal3, purpose-bound); held content becomes public only after a moderator decision.
items.pwa_impact: E2E for public community content uses text without links or contact data (auto-approved); tests of held content assert the 'Being reviewed' state only.

items.fact: Root .gitignore ignores '*.env.*' (backend re-includes backend/.env.example).
items.pwa_impact: P1 adds '!pwa/.env.example' to the root .gitignore.

items.fact: Contract 1.1.0 (Docs/40 header and Appendix D 'Contract 1.1.0', 2026-10-26; additive under TR-3, responses carry CarPal-Contract: 1.1.0) answers DI-42..DI-46: search facets (SearchRequest.facets → SearchResponse.facets), the soonest sort with a defined ResultCard.next_available_slot, the new operation search.session_get (GET /v1/search/{session_id}, 24 hours), search.page limit, MapPin slug/organization_type/verified/review_count/result_id, and map.pins judging open_now and available_within_days with MapQuery.only_matching and MapResponse.counts. Implemented by backend stage S10 'PWA integration' (backend/dev_plan.json).
items.pwa_impact: P14 adopts it after P13 (regenerated contract types, search.session_get admitted by the registry allowlist, then P14.T2-T5). The new request members (facets, only_matching, sort soonest) are refused by a 1.0.0 backend with 422 UNKNOWN_FIELD (closed schemas), so P14 starts only after backend S10 is done; check CarPal-Contract: 1.1.0 on any response first.

report.summary: P1 done. pwa/ is a hand-written Next.js 16 App Router package on the backend's local Node 24 (tools/use-local-node.{sh,ps1}, .node-version 24.21.0) with its own pnpm lockfile; shared/api-contracts (generated: operation map with routes, principals and parsed sec tags for all 406 operations / 458 routes, request/response types per operation, the 314 Docs/40 types plus the server-defined Json<…> shapes from openapi.yaml, enums, error codes, role groups), shared/i18n (EN/FA 'common' namespace, 19 keys) and shared/design-system/web (synced tokens, component CSS, fonts and licences) are linked packages or synced copies, each with a --check that fails on drift (verified by changing each source). The proxy redirects / and locale-less paths to the remembered, Accept-Language or region-default locale and stores ?theme= choices; the [locale] root layout sets <html lang dir data-theme>, links the design-system CSS from /ds and preloads only the current language's font. A placeholder home page (mirrors mobile S-AUTH-01: hero mark, word mark, promise, three trust points, language and theme links) and a localized 404 exist. Lint has two local rules (logical properties only; token-only values) plus a CSS checker, the dangerouslySetInnerHTML ban and the import boundaries; env is validated with zod at startup.

deviations: Next.js 16 names middleware 'proxy' (src/proxy.ts) and runs it on the Node.js runtime; the plan's 'middleware' means this file (P2.T8 adds the security headers there).
tsconfig exactOptionalPropertyTypes is false: the plan said 'like backend', and backend/tsconfig.json has it false. allowJs is on so the tests can import the plain-JS tools.

Design-system files are served as static files from /ds (copied from shared/design-system/web into the gitignored public/ds by `sync-design-system.mjs --public`, run by `pnpm dev` and `pnpm build`) instead of being imported into the CSS bundle, so tokens.css stays byte-identical and the current language's font can be preloaded at a stable URL. P13 may add cache-busting for /ds.

Tailwind's default colour, spacing, radius, shadow, font, text, container and breakpoint scales are reset; utilities map only to tokens. Theme keys whose name equals a token name would be self-referencing, so radii, shadows and fonts use prefixed names (rounded-ds-md, shadow-ds-1, font-latin/font-persian); breakpoints are md 768 px and xl 1200 px (Docs/22).

Experimental Next.js flags: experimental.globalNotFound (the root layout is under the dynamic [locale] segment, so unmatched URLs get app/global-not-found.tsx with its own document) and experimental.turbopackAdditionalRoots (Turbopack root stays pwa/ and follows the pnpm links into ../shared; setting outputFileTracingRoot to the repository would have made the whole repo, including backend/.data, the Turbopack root).

notFound() thrown by a page renders, in Next.js 16.4.3, as an empty server shell (<html id="__next_error__">, status 404, localized title, noindex) and the [locale]/not-found.tsx body is drawn on the client; unmatched URLs are fully server-rendered by global-not-found.tsx. Checked against Next's app-render (Fizz cannot catch the not-found error inside the client boundary). See notes_for_next.
P1 already ported a partial Icon (car, wrench, check and the proposed shield, doc, globe) to src/components/ds/icon.tsx for the placeholder; P3.T1 completes it.

The minimal server translator getTranslator() (typed dotted keys over shared/i18n) stands in for i18next until P3.T2; keys stay.
The contract package covers all 406 operations (it is shared with the portals later); the consumer allowlist is derived from it in P2 (GD-08 amendment).

notes_for_next: Every command from pwa/ after `source tools/use-local-node.sh`. `pnpm check` runs everything except build and e2e; `pnpm e2e` builds and runs Playwright on port 3100 (next start), reusing a running server outside CI.

Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before using a Next.js API: request APIs (params, cookies, headers) are async only; the proxy is src/proxy.ts; `pnpm typecheck` runs `next typegen` first (LayoutProps/PageProps helpers exist but P1 types params by hand).

Locale: the proxy guarantees the first path segment is fa or en and passes it to components without params as the x-carpal-locale request header (src/server/request-locale.ts). Its matcher skips /api, /bff, /id, /l, /_next, /ds and files with an extension — P2 adds /api/v1 and /bff route handlers and P4 the /id routes outside it, each needing its own root layout (only [locale] has one).

P3.T8 (system pages) and P5 (profiles, parts, posts: 404/410 with noindex) must pick a strategy: re-check a newer Next.js 16.x, or render the system page as the page's own content and get the status from the proxy/route (e.g. a rewrite to a status route) — record the choice.

stages.goal: The browser holds only __Host-cp_sid. The BFF signs users in through the authorization-code + PKCE flow, keeps and rotates tokens, gives guests an anonymous token, forwards the consumer operations 1:1 with CSRF protection, and the typed client implements the contract's idempotency, ETag and retry rules.
