context_to_read: Docs/40.API contract.md lines 113-176 (transport, headers), 198-228 (clients, SEC-AU), 271-320 (SEC-IC, SEC-RL), 335-376 (SEC-LT, SEC-UP, SEC-WEB), 760-912 (auth server operations)

backend/libs/auth/index.ts (CLIENTS), backend/libs/config/config.ts (signinUrl, redirect URIs), backend/modules/identity/application/auth-ops.ts (authorize, token grants), backend/apps/testing/auth-server.int.test.ts (a working end-to-end example of the flow)

tasks.task: Session store port + lite (in-memory TTL) and redis adapters (GD-08); session record: user tokens (access, refresh, expiry, acr, sid), anonymous token, csrf secret, pending intents, locale; idle and absolute lifetimes matching cp-web-consumer (12 h / 7 d).

OAuth client: /bff/login (state, nonce, PKCE S256, ui_locales, optional acr_values=aal2 for step-up, return URL validated as same-origin path) → /id/oauth/authorize; /bff/oauth/callback (state check, code exchange server-to-server, id_token nonce/iss/aud check via JWKS, session rotation on login to prevent fixation); /bff/logout (revoke refresh, drop session, clear cookie). Refresh with single-flight per session; refresh reuse/invalid_grant ends the session.

Dev topology of GD-05: Next rewrites/route for /id/oauth/*, /id/v1/auth/*, /id/.well-known/* → auth host (preserve Set-Cookie and Location; rewrite Location of the authorize 302 when it points at the internal host). Document the backend env (CARPAL_SIGNIN_URL, CARPAL_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URIS) in pwa/README and backend/.env.example (comment only).

Forwarder /api/v1/[...path]: match the path against the generated registry (consumer audience only, SEC-WEB-5; else 404), CSRF + Sec-Fetch-Site + Origin on non-GET (SEC-WEB-3), attach Bearer token (user, else anonymous), CarPal-Client, Accept-Language, CarPal-Timezone, pass Idempotency-Key/If-Match/CarPal-Request-Id; strip cookies and hop-by-hop headers both ways; pass retry/poll headers through; on 401 from an expired access token refresh once and retry; on 401 STEP_UP_REQUIRED return a typed problem the client turns into a step-up redirect.

Token providers: anonymous grant per pre-session (lazy, cached until expiry); cp-ssr client-credentials token cached process-wide; server-side typed client for RSC (uses cp-ssr, falls back to anonymous per DI-14).

Browser typed client (GD-09): api(opId, {path, query, body}) built from the operation map; CSRF token from /bff/csrf (or a meta tag); Idempotency-Key UUIDv7 for IDEM ops; If-Match for ETAG ops from a per-resource ETag cache; problem+json → ApiProblem {status, code, fields, retry_after_ms}; SEC-RL-4 retry/backoff/pause; TanStack Query provider and helpers (query keys = opId + params).
/bff/session endpoint (signed-in? display name, locale, acr; never tokens) and a useSession hook; pending-intent store API (save before sign-in, consume once after).
Security headers (GD-15) in middleware: CSP nonce + Trusted Types policy, frame-ancestors none, COOP/CORP, Permissions-Policy, Referrer-Policy; no-store on BFF and private pages.

Tests: unit (PKCE, state/nonce, allowlist matching, header hygiene, CSRF, retry policy with fake timers); int against live backend (anonymous token → config.client; full code flow with a test user created through the auth endpoints → me.get; refresh rotation; logout revokes; a forbidden {org} path → 404).

Strict-mode seams with unit tests, not enabled in lite: client-authentication strategy for /oauth/token (none | private_key_jwt), DPoP proofs on API calls for bound tokens, PoW solver hook for ATT operations (DI-22). Added by the 2026-10-25 amendment.

acceptance_criteria: No access or refresh token ever reaches the browser (checked in an int test by inspecting all responses and cookies).
A test user can sign in through /bff/login → hosted sign-in endpoints → callback, call me.get through /api/v1/me, refresh after expiry, and log out.
State-changing calls without a valid CSRF token or with a foreign Origin get 403 from the BFF.
Paths outside the consumer audience 404 at the BFF without reaching the backend.
IDEM retries reuse the same Idempotency-Key; 429 with CarPal-Retry-After-Ms is respected.
out_of_scope: mTLS and private_key_jwt (strict mode; backend GD-06)

report.summary: P2 done. The consumer BFF lives in pwa/src/server/bff/ over standard Request/Response with no Next.js imports (GD-03, BA-23) and is mounted by thin route adapters: /api/v1/[...path] (forwarder), /bff/[...path] (login, oauth/callback, logout, session, csrf, intents), /id/oauth|v1|.well-known/[...path] (auth-host proxy of GD-05). The browser holds only __Host-cp_sid (Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; 256-bit id). Sessions sit behind a store port (lite in-memory TTL store; Redis adapter over a built-in minimal RESP client, unverified) with 12 h idle / 7 d absolute lifetimes, per-session serialized read-modify-write, and id rotation at sign-in. /bff/login starts authorization code + PKCE S256 with state and nonce through the same-origin /id proxy (ui_locales from the return URL; step-up = acr_values + prompt=login); the callback checks state (single use), the RFC 9207 iss parameter, exchanges the code server-to-server, verifies the ID token (EdDSA, JWKS from the internal auth URL, iss, aud, exp, nonce, required acr for step-up), calls me.get for the display name and rotates the session; logout revokes the refresh token. Tokens: user tokens refreshed single-flight per session (invalid_grant ends the user part of the session → 401 SESSION_ENDED); guests get a lazily created pre-session with one ES256 DPoP key that binds every anonymous grant (DI-17, verified live: a guest's search session stays readable across renewals); cp-ssr client-credentials cached process-wide with a server-held anonymous fallback (DI-14). The forwarder admits exactly the GD-08 audience (161 consumer routes + 18 DRV fleet routes from the registry; canonical paths only), enforces SEC-WEB-3 CSRF (X-CSRF-Token + Sec-Fetch-Site + Origin) on state changes and refuses cross-site reads, strips browser and backend headers both ways, passes retry/poll/ETag/WWW-Authenticate headers unchanged, renews a token once on 401 and repeats the call, and caps bodies at 64 KiB. The browser typed client (src/lib/api/) calls by operation id, picks the route (me vs fleet by org_id), adds Idempotency-Key (UUIDv7, reused across automatic retries) and If-Match from an ETag cache ("v1" for a first onboarding save), maps problem+json to ApiProblem with all Problem members and the step-up challenge, implements SEC-RL-4 (server delay + 0-20 % jitter, else full-jitter backoff 500 ms/30 s/5 attempts, safe methods and IDEM only, waits > 30 s surfaced, pause after 3 consecutive 503s) and SEC-RL-3 poll pacing, and solves PoW when an ATT operation is refused (Web Worker). TanStack Query helpers (ApiProvider, useApiQuery, useApiMutation, useApiInfiniteQuery with the CURSOR_MISMATCH restart), useSession, loginUrl, saveIntent/consumeIntent and useLogout are in place; server components get ssrApi(locale). The proxy now sets the GD-15 page headers on every page incl. /id and /l: per-request nonce CSP with 'strict-dynamic', Trusted Types enforced in production (Next.js's own 'nextjs' and 'nextjs#bundler' policies only), frame-ancestors/object-src/base-uri 'none', COOP/CORP same-origin, Permissions-Policy (geolocation and camera self only), Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, HSTS in prod; private pages get private, no-store and X-Robots-Tag noindex. All P2 acceptance criteria verified: no token reaches the browser (unit and live int tests inspect every response), a fresh test user signs up and in through /bff/login → /id/oauth/authorize → /id/v1/auth/* → callback, calls me.get, refreshes after expiry and logs out (refresh token revoked at the auth server), CSRF/foreign-Origin state changes get 403, out-of-audience paths 404 without reaching the backend, IDEM retries reuse the key and 429 delays are honoured.

versions.jose: 6.2.12 (same as backend; ES256 DPoP keys and proofs, EdDSA ID-token verification, private_key_jwt assertions)
versions.redis: none: src/server/bff/session/redis.ts speaks RESP2 over node:net (GET, SET PX, DEL, AUTH, SELECT)

deviations: Docs/40 Url is https-only, so the backend rejects redirect_uri=http://localhost:3000/bff/oauth/callback (422 pattern). The plan's GD-05 dev values were http; they are now https (GD-05 P2 amendment). Guest browsing and the forwarder work on http://localhost:3000, but finishing a browser sign-in needs the PWA served over https: logged as DI-24, decision for P4 in OQ-10. The P2 integration tests call the BFF handlers directly with origin https://localhost:3000, so they need no TLS.

The /id proxy rewrites redirects that point at the issuer (https://id.carpal.app/...) or at the internal auth URL to <origin>/id/...; with that, CARPAL_SIGNIN_URL is optional in dev (the default <issuer>/signin lands on /id/signin). It forwards only the __Host-cp_ia cookie and returns only __Host-cp_ia Set-Cookies; /oauth/token and /oauth/revoke are not exposed to the browser (404). It also enforces Origin + Sec-Fetch-Site on state changes (a partial stand-in for DI-09 until the auth host checks them).

The callback reports failures to the page as ?signin=<outcome> on the return URL (expired | state | issuer | cancelled | failed | step_up); P4 renders the messages. No code, token or error description ever goes into the URL.

Pending intents (GD-06) are an API, not part of the login request: POST /bff/intents {type, target?, return_to, draft?} (≤ 8 KiB, ≤ 5 per session, 30 min), listed in /bff/session.pending_intents, consumed once with POST /bff/intents/<id>/consume. They are carried into the rotated session at sign-in.

The BFF passes STEP_UP_REQUIRED through unchanged (SEC-WEB-1: no added fields) together with the WWW-Authenticate challenge; the browser client parses acr_values/max_age from that header into ApiProblem.stepUp. BFF-generated problems use the contract shape with BFF codes CSRF_FAILED (403, with reason), SESSION_ENDED (401), BAD_GATEWAY (502/503) and INTERNAL (500).

Retries (GD-09): automatic retry statuses are 429, 502, 503, 504 and network errors; 500 is not retried, and 503 AI_UNAVAILABLE is never retried (it is a state, GD-13). A paused operation fails fast with code PAUSED and retryAfterMs. CURSOR_MISMATCH restarts are done by useApiInfiniteQuery (reset to the first page), not by every api() call.

CSP: Trusted Types are enforced only in production builds; next dev (React refresh, error overlay) assigns script URLs and HTML without a policy, so dev gets 'unsafe-eval', ws: and no Trusted Types. style-src has no 'unsafe-inline': server-rendered style="…" attributes would be blocked (P3 note). Verified in the built app: every Next.js script carries the nonce, hydration works, no CSP or Trusted Types violation in Chromium.

The proxy matcher now runs on /id/* and /l/* pages (security headers and noindex only, no locale routing) and still skips /api, /bff, /id/oauth, /id/v1, /id/.well-known, /_next, /ds and files; src/proxy.ts imports serverEnv (server-only) without problems in Next.js 16.4.3.

New env vars: CARPAL_API_AUDIENCE (DPoP htu of API calls, default https://api.carpal.app) and CARPAL_STRICT_AUTH (0|1; 1 = PoW up front for the anonymous grant). The BFF reports itself as CarPal-Client cp-web-consumer/<package.json version> (web 1.0); SSR calls use cp-ssr/<version>, or cp-web-consumer when they fall back to the anonymous token (CarPal-Client must equal the token's client_id).

DI-14 checked live: the backend does not enforce token scopes per operation, so a cp-ssr token can call search.run (200). The SSR client still falls back to the anonymous token on a 401 (after one fresh cp-ssr token). New concern DI-26: all cp-ssr calls share one anonymous rate-limit key.

P1 test tools/contract/generate.test.ts got a 30 s timeout: regenerating all 406 operations exceeded the 5 s default once while 21 test workers and the backend shared the machine (no drift; contract:check was green).
backend/: comment-only lines in backend/.env.example (the PWA dev env, P2.T3) and a handoff note in backend/dev_plan.json; no backend code changed.
notes_for_next: P3: wrap the app in <ApiProvider> (src/lib/api/query.tsx) in the [locale] layout or the app shell; P2 did not touch the layouts. Client code imports '@/lib/api' (core), '@/lib/api/query' (hooks) and '@/lib/api/session' (useSession, loginUrl, saveIntent, consumeIntent, useLogout). Server components use ssrApi(locale).api(opId, …) from '@/server/ssr/api'.

SameSite=Strict means the first navigation from another site (a search engine, an email link) arrives WITHOUT the session cookie, so server rendering sees a guest even for a signed-in user. The (app) layout must not redirect to sign-in on the server just because the cookie is missing: render the shell and let the client confirm with /bff/session (same-origin fetches do carry the cookie), or do a same-origin reload. Decide this in P3/P4 and record it.

P4 needs HTTPS for a real browser sign-in (DI-24, OQ-10): backend redirect URIs must be https. Options: `next dev --experimental-https` (mkcert installs a local CA — ask the user first) or a local TLS proxy; then set CARPAL_PWA_ORIGIN=https://localhost:3000, CARPAL_SIGNIN_URL=https://localhost:3000/id/signin and the redirect URI of README. Playwright then needs ignoreHTTPSErrors or the CA.

P4 hosted UI: call auth-host operations through the same client (api('auth.signin_password', …) goes to /id/v1/auth/signin with the interaction cookie); ATT operations solve PoW automatically when refused. Completion = navigate to the same /id/oauth/authorize URL the browser came from (keep it from the first request; the callback is /bff/oauth/callback). Show ?signin=<outcome> messages on the return page.

Step-up: catch ApiProblem.stepUp (401 STEP_UP_REQUIRED) → save the action with saveIntent() → location = loginUrl({ stepUp: problem.stepUp.acrValues }) → on return consumeIntent() and replay. SESSION_ENDED (401) means the BFF dropped the user: refresh the session view (ApiProvider does it) and show the signed-out state.

CSP: nonces need dynamic rendering (the [locale] layout reads cookies, so every page is dynamic today); a statically rendered page would ship scripts without the nonce and break. Any library that sets script URLs or HTML (MapLibre workers in P6, a service worker in P12) must get its Trusted Types policy name added to TRUSTED_TYPES_POLICIES in src/server/security-headers.ts and, for blob workers, worker-src blob: — test in a production build (dev does not enforce Trusted Types). No style attributes in server-rendered markup unless style-src-attr is added deliberately.

Map tiles and media: the CSP img-src/media-src/connect-src take CARPAL_STORAGE_URL and the origin of CARPAL_PWA_MAP_STYLE_URL; a tile host from config.client (GD-12) must be added there too when P6 uses it.

Rate limits (DI-25): every BFF token call and every hosted-UI /v1/auth/* call reaches the auth host from one IP, and auth.signin allows 30 per 15 min per IP prefix. Keep CARPAL_RATE_LIMIT_SCALE=100 for local test runs and expect 429s on a shared dev backend otherwise. The BFF passes the 429/503 delay to the browser (BAD_GATEWAY with retry_after_ms for token-endpoint backpressure).

test:int needs the backend: `pnpm dev` in backend/ with the env in pwa/README.md (https redirect URI, CARPAL_RATE_LIMIT_SCALE=100). It signs fresh @test.carpal.app users up and reads backend/.data/outbox-mail.jsonl for the verification link. The e2e test that forwards to the backend skips itself when the backend is down.

Redis store (OQ-06): refresh single-flight is per process. With several PWA instances behind the Redis store, two instances can refresh the same session at once and the second use trips refresh-reuse detection (family revoked → user signed out). Before multi-instance production, add a distributed lock (SET NX PX) around refresh or pin sessions to an instance.
Analytics (GD-17) and the PoW worker: src/lib/api/pow.worker.ts is loaded with new Worker(new URL(…)); if a Trusted Types or CSP refusal blocks it the solver falls back to the main thread in slices.
report.tests_after_stage: pnpm check green (lint; typecheck; 170 Vitest tests in 21 files — new for P2: BFF flow, forwarder, allowlist, CSRF/crypto/http, sessions + Redis adapter against an in-process RESP server, token client incl. strict-mode seams (DPoP nonce retry, PoW hook, private_key_jwt, JWKS refetch), endpoints/intents, /id proxy, SSR credentials, page security headers, proxy headers/matcher, typed client and retry policy, browser transport, TanStack helpers; contract:check; i18n:check; ds:check). pnpm test:int: 6 tests green against backend `pnpm dev` (lite) with the README env — guest anonymous token → config.client; guest search session survives an anonymous renewal (DI-17); full sign-up → email verification (outbox) → sign-in → callback → me.get → refresh after expiry → rotated-out token refused and reuse revokes the family → second sign-in → logout revokes the refresh token; no token in any browser response; out-of-audience paths 404 without a backend call; cp-ssr accepted by search.run (DI-14). pnpm e2e: 13 Playwright tests in Chromium (P1 smoke + security spec: nonce CSP with Trusted Types and no violation in the built app, private pages no-store/noindex, allowlist 404s, CSRF 403s, guest session cookie attributes, forwarding to the backend through the built server across route bundles). Run twice more for stability: all green (one cold first run had two font checks fail and pass on rerun; watch for flakiness).

report.summary: P3 done. Design system: typed React ports of every bundle.js component with the same classes and props, the mobile/preview kit.js additions (47 more icons, Chip iconEnd/toggle, TextField prefix/end, IconButton, outlined SafetyBanner, Urgency, 48 px tap extension) and CSP-safe avatar sizes. i18n: i18next runtime with per-area namespaces (common, shell, states, system, consent, format, vehicle; 165 EN/FA keys), server translations refreshed from the CDN dictionary when config.client announces a newer version, client providers fed only the namespaces they need, Persian-digit plurals; formatters for numbers/digit strings, Jalali and Gregorian dates (24 h in fa), relative time, IRR in toman, "about x km" and <Bidi>. Theme: stored choice or automatic (prefers-contrast → Sunlight, prefers-color-scheme → Night) applied before the first paint by a nonce'd boot script, followed live, switchable from links that also work without JavaScript. Shell: (shell) route group with (public) and (app) pages and an @rail parallel-route slot; global header with the logo, a WAI-ARIA combobox search ('/' shortcut, taxonomy.suggest typeahead in any language incl. transliteration, Browse on map, vehicle context chip when signed in), Help Me, guest language switch with Log in / Sign up or the signed-in bell (unread count, 99+) and avatar menu; left navigation (labels ≥ 1200 px, icons 768-1199 px, Your garage box), right rail (≥ 1200 px, max three boxes, Join CarPal for guests, Featured only with featured.enabled), bottom tab bar for signed-in phones, guest menu drawer, footer with cookie settings, language and theme. Global patterns: toast with Undo (bottom-start, 5 s), native-dialog modal/drawer/sheet, URL-addressable modals (refresh reopens, Back closes), the auth-intent modal wired to the BFF pending-intent API with exactly-once replay, pointer-only hover cards, infinite list with restoration and Back to top, skeletons, error boundaries with Retry and the GD-13 state components; (app) pages behind a client session gate. Cookie consent banner (Accept all / Reject non-essential / Choose at equal prominence) in a first-party cookie, read by the typed analytics queue skeleton with a drift test against the backend registry. config.client cached per language on the server (stale-while-revalidate, region-file fallback with every flag off, 30 s failure backoff), taxonomy snapshots cached by taxonomy version on server and client, brand → model → series vehicle picker. W-SYS-01 pages with real statuses: 404/403 from notFound()/forbidden(), 410 and 503 maintenance through a proxy status rewrite, suspended as a 200 + noindex body. Two Next.js 16.4.3 production issues found and fixed on the way (Turbopack build hang on the PoW worker cycle; Turbopack runtime without Trusted Types policies). All acceptance criteria verified except the browser round trip of criterion 3, which needs the hosted sign-in (P4) and local https (OQ-10): its parts are covered by DOM tests (save → hosted sign-in URL; return → consume once → replay → toast) and by E2E up to /bff/login with the intent stored in the pre-session.

versions.i18next: 26.4.3 (26.5.10 was released the day before; the newest release at least two weeks old was taken)

deviations: Acceptance criterion 3 (gated demo action survives sign-in end to end) is verified in parts: DOM tests run the whole loop with the real providers (guest → context modal → POST /bff/intents → /bff/login with the return URL; signed-in return → consume once → handler → toast; other pages' intents untouched), and Playwright runs the guest half against the production build (the intent is listed in /bff/session.pending_intents with return_to /en/dev-kit and the browser goes to /bff/login?return_to=%2Fen%2Fdev-kit&locale=en). The browser sign-in itself needs the hosted sign-in UI (P4) and local https (DI-24, OQ-10); the full round trip is a P4 amendment.

Signed-in shell variants (left navigation, tab bar, bell, avatar menu, garage box, vehicle chip) are verified by DOM tests; the Playwright layout matrix (EN/FA × light/sun/dark × 375/1024/1440) runs the guest shell, because no browser sign-in exists before P4.

Next.js 16.4.3 Turbopack production build hung forever without an error when (a) src/lib/api/pow.worker.ts imported pow.ts, which itself creates new Worker(new URL('./pow.worker.ts')) — a cycle P2 never bundled into a route — and (b) a module imported a JSON file outside pwa/ by relative path (../../../shared/region-config). Fixed by moving the pure search to pow-search.ts and by making shared/region-config a linked package (@carpal/region-config, package.json added there; the backend reads the file by path and is unaffected). next dev reported (b) as a module-not-found error; webpack builds both fine.

Trusted Types: the Turbopack runtime of Next.js 16.4.3 uses no policy (P2 assumed nextjs/nextjs#bundler), so lazily loaded chunks (e.g. error.tsx on a slow first response) were blocked in production and the page went blank or never hydrated. Added a narrow "default" policy to the boot script and to the CSP (GD-15 P3 amendment); returning an absolute URL from createScriptURL broke Turbopack's chunk lookup (no hydration on cold loads), so the policy returns the URL unchanged.

CSS layering: the design system's bundle.css is unlayered, so P3 rules in @layer components could not override it (the guest menu button and the tab bar stayed visible on desktop). additions.css and shell.css are unlayered and use compound selectors where they refine a cp- class; P1's pwa-wordmark/hero/tile stay in @layer components.

System pages: App Router pages can produce only 404/403/401, so 410 and 503 come from a proxy rewrite to the internal /<locale>/system/<kind> route with the status (marked by x-carpal-system, which the proxy strips from client requests; a direct visit is 404). Maintenance: CARPAL_PWA_MAINTENANCE (on | ISO end time) answers every localized page with 503 + Retry-After. Suspended (200 + noindex) is a page body for P5. System pages use the bundled dictionary (no config or API call) so they render with the backend down. notFound()/forbidden() bodies are still client-drawn inside an empty 404/403 shell (P1 note; unchanged in 16.4.3).

Dictionary: common.notFound moved to system.notFound (W-SYS-01 texts); the P1 home strings stay in common.home. Counts use {{count, number}}; tools/i18n-check.ts accepts placeholders with a format suffix. The CDN refresh is unit-tested only (the backend reports i18n version "dev" and no CDN exists).

Theme picker: links to ?theme=<choice> enhanced by an onClick, not radio inputs, so it works before hydration and without JavaScript (the P1 no-JS switch kept); an "Automatic" choice deletes the cookie (?theme=auto in the proxy).
Layout reading of Docs/22 §2.1 tablet "two columns: main + one rail": the rail is the icon navigation; the right-rail boxes show from 1200 px (OQ-16).
Active vehicle per browser (DI-27); suggestions limited to 5 types and paused after a 429 (DI-28); IRR shown in toman and Asia/Tehran as the default time zone (DI-29, OQ-11, OQ-13).

(app) session gate: the server never redirects (SameSite=Strict); the client sends guests to /bff/login with the return URL, unless ?signin=<outcome> is present (then a "Log in to see this page" state, no loop). Every shell destination has a placeholder page with the GD-13 "not available yet" state, so navigation never 404s.

notes_for_next: P4: make /bff/login honour screen=signup (sent by every Sign up link and the intent modal); show ?signin=<outcome> messages (e.g. a toast in the shell; SessionGate already shows a log-in state when it is present); wire the SESSION_ENDED toast (key shell.session.ended) to ApiProvider onSessionEnded; Switch account should force an account choice (prompt=login). Then run the full browser round trip of the dev-kit Follow action (P3 acceptance criterion 3): Follow → Log in → hosted sign-in → back on /<locale>/dev-kit → toast "You are following Reza Auto Suspension" and the button shows Following.

Where pages go: src/app/[locale]/(shell)/(public)/… (guest-readable, inside the shell) and (shell)/(app)/… (behind SessionGate). Full-screen flows without the shell (Help Me wizard, review form) need a sibling route group next to (shell). Replace the placeholder page of a destination when its stage builds it (header comment names the screen). Right-rail boxes: add @rail/<same path>/page.tsx (RailBox, max three; FeaturedBox only renders with featured.enabled).

Building blocks: useT() / serverI18n(locale) (add a namespace per area: shared/i18n top-level key + CLIENT_NAMESPACES or <I18nNamespaces>); useFormat() / createFormatter(); useFlag(), useRegion(), loadClientConfig(); useTaxonomyNodes() / taxonomy().nodes(); <VehiclePicker>; useToast(); useUrlModal(name, paramKeys) + <UrlModal>; <Dialog variant=modal|drawer|sheet>; useGatedAction() + useIntentHandler(); <HoverCard>; <InfiniteList> (+ BackToTop); Skeleton*; <StateView> + stateFromProblem(); <ErrorBoundary>; useAnalytics().track(); useActiveVehicle()/useVehicleLabel(); ds components from @/components/ds.

System pages in P5: 404 → notFound(); suspended profile → render <SystemPage kind="suspended"> with robots noindex (200); removed content → OQ-14 (a real 410 needs the proxy: systemRewrite(request, locale, 'gone', headers) after a cheap check).

Trusted Types: the default policy admits only same-origin /_next/static/ script URLs and markup-free HTML. MapLibre (P6) and the service worker (P12) need their own named policies in TRUSTED_TYPES_POLICIES (and worker-src blob: for blob workers); always test in a production build (dev does not enforce Trusted Types).

Build gotchas (Next.js 16.4.3 Turbopack): never import a file outside pwa/ by relative path (the production build hangs) — add a linked package; never let a Web Worker module import the module that starts it. CSS that refines a cp- design-system class must be unlayered with a compound selector.

P6: /<locale>/search reads sessionStorage "cp:pending-search" ({text, node?: {id, type, name}, at}), runs search.run, moves to /<locale>/search/<session_id> and clears the key. taxonomy.suggest shares the guest search bucket (DI-28).

P7: the vehicle chip and garage box use the per-browser active vehicle (DI-27); signed-in right-rail boxes (Your car, Needs your attention) are still to build (DefaultRail shows Join CarPal for guests only).

E2E: gotoReady(page, url) waits for data-hydrated before clicking; decideCookies(context, baseURL) keeps the cookie banner closed; layout tests use the dev kit (test.setTimeout 90 s for the three-viewport axe runs). The suite passes without the backend (the forwarding test skips) and fully with it.

config.client: when the backend is down the first request of each language waits CONFIG_TIMEOUT_MS (2 s) once per 30 s backoff, then serves the region file with every flag off; production should never see this path for long.

report.summary: P4 done. Hosted sign-in (W-AUTH-01) at /id/signin: its own root layout over the shared document (src/app/root-document.tsx, language from ui_locales), one page whose steps are client state (src/features/auth): identify with a mobile number or email (phones normalised to E.164 with the region code, Persian digits accepted, out-of-region numbers refused before sending) → a code (default, method remembered per device) or the password (email only) → the second factor when the account has one (TOTP, recovery code, passkey) → complete; 'Sign in with a passkey' (auth.webauthn_options purpose signin + auth.mfa_verify webauthn, @simplewebauthn/browser 14); sign-up (name, email, optional mobile and password with strength meter and rules, required Terms and Privacy with version dialogs, optional marketing and AI personalisation unticked) verified by an emailed code (otp purpose verify; a text to the mobile instead when given); 6-box code input with paste/autofill, 60 s resend, 'get it by email/text instead'; forgot password (always the same answer); timed lock from 429 with countdown; expired interaction (410) with 'Start again' that keeps the return URL; 'Keep me signed in' (browser-session cookie when off); context line from the gated action; every message localized and enumeration-safe (breached password, out-of-region SMS, taken email per BA-13). Link pages /l/ev#token (email verification) and /l/pr#token (new password) read the fragment, clear it and POST it. /<locale>/login and /signup start the flow (Docs/22 §6). Completion re-requests the authorize URL kept in the /id proxy's resume cookie (without prompt=login, DI-34). Web onboarding (W-ONB-01) at /<locale>/onboarding outside the shell: role (business choices → portal sign-up), first car (brand → model → series, year, optional pasted VIN cleaned like the backend, mileage, nickname; saved with vehicles.create, then the VIN decoder's suggestions with Use/Keep; 409 DUPLICATE with vin_transfer_available → 'Did you buy this car?' → vehicles.transfer_request; 'Where do I find my VIN?' and a QR code 'Continue on your phone'), anything wrong (description + symptom chips kept as a Help Me draft), permissions (location with the location_usage consent); Next saves (If-Match "v<version>", "v1" creates), Skip on 2-4, resume at the saved step, 'Finish later'; finishing writes the browser's time zone to the account and the optional sign-up consents become consent records + preferences. Every ordinary sign-in returns through /<locale>/onboarding?next=<page> (P4.T7): onboarded accounts go straight on, then the page replays the pending intent; signed-in visitors of the landing page go to /home. Shell: ?signin=<outcome> and SESSION_ENDED toasts, 'Switch account' with prompt=login. BFF: screen/intent/prompt on /bff/login and loginHint for the hosted page, /bff/login/restart, the resume cookie, keep-signed-in, intent labels, the dev-only redirect shim, the corrected step-up rule (BA-11) and one pre-session per page (DI-36). User answers: OQ-11 per-browser USD → toman/rial price display in Settings → On this device; OQ-13 CARPAL_PWA_DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE. All acceptance criteria verified in the browser: Sara's Ch. 1-3 path (sign up, verify by code, BMW 3 Series E90 'Silver', sign out, password sign-in, code sign-in in another browser context showing the car), the gated Follow returning followed, and localized enumeration-safe errors (DOM tests per error).
deviations: No local https (OQ-10 answer). The browser sign-in still runs on http://localhost: CARPAL_PWA_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI (dev/E2E only, refused in prod) registers the https callback, and the /id proxy rewrites the auth host's redirect to it back to <origin>/bff/oauth/callback; the code exchange uses the registered URI. playwright.config.ts sets it for port 3100 and the backend env lists https://localhost:3100/bff/oauth/callback (pwa/README.md, backend/.env.example comment).

The hosted sign-in is one route with client-side steps (planned: signin, signup, verify, reset, mfa, locked routes); Back within the flow uses the Change/Back links. The resume URL comes from a cookie the /id proxy sets (__Host-cp_iar), not from the original request (the hosted page never sees it); the restart goes through a new /bff/login/restart?state= instead of a bare /bff/login, so the return URL, level, screen and intent survive (pending logins are remembered 12 h only for this).

Hints for the hosted page (screen=signup, the intent's label) are read on the server from the BFF session store by the authorize state; this needs the hosted UI on the BFF's origin and store (GD-05 topology). The intent got an optional label (≤ 160 characters).

auth.authorize never resumes a prompt=login request, so the resume drops prompt; the callback's step-up check now requires a fresh authentication (auth_time ≥ start − 5 s) and the level only for aal3 — the P2 check refused every aal2 step-up of an account without a second factor (BA-11, DI-34; verified live).

Contract-driven: email required at sign-up, password sign-in with email only, reset by email link (DI-35); verification by code uses otp purpose verify (the ev link still works); suspended/deactivated/appeal/'remaining attempts'/'Number not registered' not shown (DI-33, OQ-17); 'Contact support' omitted (OQ-18); optional consents applied after the first sign-in from the tab's sessionStorage (DI-30); policy versions from env (CARPAL_PWA_TERMS_VERSION/PRIVACY_VERSION) because config.client has none; the legal texts wait for the legal review (OQ-15).

W-ONB-01 has 4 steps: 'Your interests' is not offered (no feed-preference operation, flag off; DI-31). VIN decode after saving (DI-32). 'Get help' keeps the draft (localStorage cp:help-draft, readHelpDraft() from @/features/onboarding) and continues instead of opening Help Me (P10). Business choices only link to the portal (no business flow saved). The resumed flow's If-Match comes from the list item's version (onboarding.list has no per-item ETag header); later saves use each response's version. Required fields are checked on submit with named errors instead of a disabled Create account button (a11y).

Every ordinary sign-in passes /<locale>/onboarding?next= (one extra navigation for onboarded accounts) so onboarding comes before the intent replay; a failed sign-in passes its ?signin outcome on to the page. loginUrl() moved to src/lib/api/login-url.ts (buildLoginUrl, usable on the server); useLoginHref drops a previous ?signin.

One pre-session per page (DI-36, found by the gated-action E2E): every api-host call of the browser now waits for the page's shared /bff/csrf (sharedCsrfSource), so a first API call and a first intent save can no longer create two pre-sessions.

Root layouts: [locale], /id and /l share src/app/root-document.tsx (P3 had the document inline in the [locale] layout); the proxy sets x-carpal-locale for /id (ui_locales, else cookie/Accept-Language) and /l pages. /onboarding, /login and /signup are private (no-store, noindex).

OQ-11/OQ-13 built here though not in the P4 task list: Settings → On this device → Prices (cp_price cookie; the rest of the settings page stays 'not available yet' until P9) and CARPAL_PWA_DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE. formatMoney keeps IRR in the chosen unit and shows USD as '$x' / 'x دلار' unless converted.

Proposed DS additions from kit.js: Check (native checkbox row), Meter and StepBar (width classes in 5 % steps because of the CSP); FlowFrame (src/components/shell/flow-frame.tsx) for full-screen flows; useBrowserValue() (src/lib/browser-value.ts) for browser-only values without setState in effects; isolate() in src/lib/format/bidi.tsx for phone numbers and emails inside translated sentences.
notes_for_next: Sign-in links: always loginUrl()/useLoginHref() (or /<locale>/login?next=…); they return through the onboarding check. Step-ups: loginUrl({ stepUp: 'aal2' }) comes straight back. Gated actions: gate({ type, target, draft, title, run }) — the title becomes the hosted sign-in's context line.

Never create BFF sessions from parallel first requests: browser code that calls the BFF must go through the typed client or the session helpers (they share sharedCsrfSource()); a raw fetch to /api/v1 or /bff/* on a fresh page can recreate the DI-36 race.

Prices: format every amount with useFormat().money(amount, currency) or createFormatter(…, prices) on the server (the [locale] layout already passes the cp_price choice into FormatProvider; server components that format money must read parsePriceDisplay(cookies().get(PRICE_COOKIE)) themselves). Do not hard-code toman.

P5: OQ-14 is answered — removed posts and questions render the 'no longer available' page with status 200 + noindex. The landing page placeholder already redirects signed-in visitors to /home (server when the cookie is present, SignedInRedirect otherwise); keep that when P5 replaces it.

P7: the onboarding sets the browser's active vehicle (cp:active-vehicle) to the first car; W-GAR-03 can reuse src/features/onboarding/vin.ts (cleanVin, vinProblem) and the transfer pattern of vehicle-step.tsx (TransferRequest); the garage's 'Ownership requests' block is still to build (BA-04).

P8: add 'Your interests' to the onboarding (STEPS in src/features/onboarding/onboarding.tsx) when the feed flag is on and a preference operation exists (DI-31); 'Nearby shops to follow' via follows.put.

P9: Settings already renders 'On this device' (PriceDisplaySettings from @/features/settings); build the account sections around it. MFA enrolment, passkey registration and the session list are P9 (the hosted sign-in already verifies TOTP, recovery codes and passkeys). The optional sign-up consents are granted by the onboarding (applySignupChoices) — the consent settings should show them.
P10: Help Me starts from readHelpDraft() (@/features/onboarding; localStorage cp:help-draft {vehicleId, text, symptoms, at}) and should clear it once used.

Local runs: start the backend with the env of pwa/README.md (redirect URIs for :3000 and :3100, CARPAL_RATE_LIMIT_SCALE=100); set CARPAL_PWA_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI in pwa/.env.local to sign in on http://localhost:3000. E2E helpers: tests/e2e/accounts.ts (createUser, mailedCode, mailedLinkToken). Use fresh VINs per run (one owner per VIN).

Open with the backend owner (noted in backend/dev_plan.json): policy versions in config.client and optional consents on auth.signup (DI-30), a feed-preference operation (DI-31), a pre-save VIN decode (DI-32), a suspended-account signal (DI-33, OQ-17), the prompt=login resume contract (DI-34), whether amounts are stored in USD now (OQ-11 answer, DI-29) and a server-side remedy for concurrent pre-sessions when the BFF moves (DI-36, NI-08).
report.tests_after_stage: pnpm check green (lint; typecheck; 329 Vitest tests in 41 files — new for P4: hosted sign-in steps (sign-up → verify by code → completion, breached password, password → MFA TOTP/recovery, phone → SMS code with E.164 and masking, out-of-region numbers, wrong code, 429 lock countdown, 410 restart, unknown interaction, forgot password), link pages (/l/ev results incl. used/expired/taken, /l/pr length/confirmation/breached/used), onboarding (onboarded → next, failed sign-in pass-through, guest → sign-in, full new-account path with If-Match v1→v4, VIN suggestion, active vehicle, sign-up consents and time zone; resume with Help Me draft; 'Did you buy this car?'; validation), price display settings, sign-in notices and Switch account, identifier/password/VIN/login-URL/price-cookie units, BFF hints/restart/keep-signed-in/step-up freshness/resume cookie/redirect shim/intent labels; contract:check; i18n:check (402 keys); ds:check; prettier clean). pnpm build green (Turbopack). pnpm test:int: 9 green against backend pnpm dev (new hosted-signin.int.test.ts: sign-up without password verified by code and completed through the resume cookie into the onboarding return, first onboarding save with If-Match "v1"; aal2 step-up of an account without MFA through prompt=login and the prompt-less resume; password reset with the same answer for unknown addresses, breached password, LINK_USED). pnpm e2e: 33 Playwright tests green twice in a row after a fresh build — new auth.spec: Sara's Ch. 1-3 path in EN, Persian sign-up (rtl) with 'Finish later', the gated Follow round trip through the real hosted sign-in, forgot password → /l/pr → sign-in with the new password; axe clean on the hosted sign-in, onboarding steps and /l/pr; P3 specs updated for the onboarding return.

stages.title: Public SEO pages: landing, provider, vendor, part, showcase
amendments: 2026-10-25 (P4): OQ-14 answered — removed posts and questions show the W-SYS-01 "no longer available" body with status 200 + noindex. The landing placeholder redirects signed-in visitors to /<locale>/home (server + SignedInRedirect); keep that. Format prices with useFormat().money (USD base, per-browser conversion, OQ-11).

2026-10-25 (P3): public pages live in src/app/[locale]/(shell)/(public)/ (replace the landing placeholder there); 404 via notFound(), suspended profiles = <SystemPage kind="suspended"> + noindex (200), removed content per OQ-14 (a real 410 needs the proxy systemRewrite); profile.viewed etc. through useAnalytics().track() (consent-gated).
2026-10-25: read BA-06, BA-16, BA-20, BA-27, BA-28, BA-33 and DI-10 (decided), DI-14 (still to test), DI-20 first.
public.availability now computes slots (backend S7); providers without availability rules return none → the Request card shows 'Request anyway' (BA-19).

stages.goal: Server-rendered, indexable public pages that turn a search-engine visitor into a follower, a request or an inquiry, within the 2.5 s LCP budget.

tasks.task: SEO kit: generateMetadata per page (title/description per locale, canonical, hreflang fa/en, Open Graph preview image = cover/after-photo), JSON-LD builders (Organization, LocalBusiness/AutoRepair with AggregateRating from published reviews, AutoPartsStore, Product/Offer for parts with public price only, Article/ImageObject), robots.txt and sitemap index (provider, vendor, part, showcase URLs from public reads), noindex rules of §6.

W-PUB-01 landing: hero with Your car picker + 'What's wrong' field → search (P6 opens results; until then a stub route), How it works, trust explained + 'How ranking works' static page, popular specialists near (city picker; IP-based city is optional), recent showcases, for businesses, footer; states (no city, no providers).

W-PUB-02 provider profile at /<locale>/shop/<slug>: header band (badges with popovers, rating, area, response time, Follow/Save/Share/Report), anchored sections with sticky section menu (Overview, Services & Capabilities matrix with 'Only my car', Portfolio grid opening showcases in a modal, Reviews two-column with filters and the two verification labels, Location & Hours with static preview and Get directions, Q&A link), sticky Request card (vehicle chip, fit line, next slots from public.availability or 'Request anyway' → P10 request step), Call reveal (DI-10); states (pending verification, no reviews, suspended noindex, merged 301).

W-PUB-03 vendor profile at /<locale>/parts-seller/<slug>: header band, Parts (search within vendor, filters, grid; no listing without a term beyond page 1), Fitment coverage table, Reviews with vendor sub-ratings, Location; 'Ask about a part' card; trade prices never rendered (only the 'Trade prices for verified businesses' note).

W-PUB-08 part page /<locale>/parts/<vendor-slug>/<item_id>-<slug> (DI-13): gallery, numbers, condition, price or 'Price on request', stock with last update, warranty, fitment table highlighting the visitor's car, vendor card, Ask about stock (auth-intent → inquiries.create form as C-INV-03), alternatives labelled AI suggestion if present; out of stock = 200, removed = 410.

W-PUB-05 showcase page /<locale>/post/<id>-<slug>: author header, before/after slider (drag, arrow keys, click toggle), consent indicator, linked provider card, right rail 'Request similar service' and more from this provider; modal over profiles with URL; removed 410; comments/reactions placeholders for P8.
Media rendering: signed public media URLs with fixed aspect boxes, lazy loading, sizes/srcset where variants exist; images from the media host allowed in CSP.

Tests: RSC render tests with fixtures; E2E on a seeded provider and vendor (create them through backend fixtures or API as a business user), check JSON-LD validity, hreflang, status codes; Lighthouse-style LCP check on the provider page (local, throttled).

acceptance_criteria: View-source of a provider page contains the content, JSON-LD, canonical and hreflang; no trade price, no private data.
Follow/Save as a guest goes through sign-in and completes on return.
Suspended and removed content return the documented HTTP status and noindex.

report.summary: P5 done. W-PUB-01 landing (/<locale>): hero with Your car (brand → model → series) and What's wrong → the search page through sessionStorage (the car as brand/model/series filters and the chosen city, BA-16; P6 runs the search), How it works, Trust explained with the new static /<locale>/how-ranking-works page (Docs/54 §5 and §2.1 rules in words, no weights), popular specialists of the chosen city (GET form ?city=, remembered in the cp_city cookie; search.run chosen_city, six cards), recent showcases from feed.discover, For businesses → portal sign-up; states: no city chosen (the picker comes first) and no providers ("We're launching in Tehran first" + sign-up); signed-in visitors still go to /home. W-PUB-02 provider profile /<locale>/shop/<slug>: header band (cover = portfolio thumbnail, logo, type, Verified Business or Verification pending, badges with scope and native-popover explanations, rating and count, city, price tier, measured response time or target, Follow / Save / Share), sticky section menu with scroll spy, Overview (description, facts, verified certifications, amenities), Services & Capabilities matrix (vehicle rows × service-system columns, the evidence level as word and colour, stacked on phones, 'Only my car' for the active vehicle, collapsed self-declared group), Portfolio grid with repair-area filters opening showcases in a URL modal from 768 px, Reviews in two columns (overall, distribution meters, sub-ratings, the two confirmation paths explained; list with the Verified visit / Approved labels and their rules, Disputed, context, tags, media, business reply, Helpful through reactions.put and the auth intent; filters verified only, recent/helpful, critical, stars), Location & Hours (static preview with Open the map, address with Copy or the approximate area, Get directions from the region's navigation_apps, service radius, Saturday-first hours with today and open now, access instructions), a Q&A link while qna.enabled; the Request card (right rail from 1200 px through @rail, inline below): vehicle chip or Select your car, Fit for your car from the public capabilities, the primary location's next slots grouped by day (public.availability) or Request anyway, Request appointment → /<locale>/help?provider=&location=&slot= (P10) through the auth intent, Call (number loaded on click, never in the HTML; search.result_event 'selected' when a search result opened the profile, DI-10), today's hours. W-PUB-03 vendor profile /<locale>/parts-seller/<slug>: header (seller type, pickup/delivery), Overview (categories, brands, warranty and returns, trade note), Parts (search within the seller, category chips, Fits my car, grid with the public price or Price on request and stock; first page server-rendered; no page beyond the first without a search term), Fitment coverage, Reviews (seller sub-ratings, Verified purchase wording), Location; the rail holds Ask about a part, hours, map preview and directions. W-PUB-08 part page /<locale>/parts/<vendor-slug>/<item_id>-<slug>: gallery with thumbnails, brand and name, public price, stock, Ask about stock (auth intent keeping the form draft, then inquiries.create with quantity, message and optional vehicle context through vendor_fitment_context), facts (condition, type, category, position, warranty, OE and maker numbers), description, fitment with the visitor's car highlighted and confidence labels, seller card and directions; wrong slugs move permanently to the canonical URL; slugs follow each language's name, alternates read in the other language. W-PUB-05 showcase /<locale>/post/<id>-<slug> (showcases.get): labels and context chips, before/after slider (drag, range keys, toggle; CSSOM clip; both photos side by side without JavaScript), title, text, dates, tags, gallery, provider card with Follow; rail with Request similar service and more from this provider; the same body in the portfolio modal. SEO kit (src/server/ssr/seo): pageMetadata (title, description, canonical, hreflang fa/en/x-default, Open Graph and Twitter, robots), the JSON-LD serializer (escapes < > & and U+2028/2029; nonce'd data block) and builders (Organization, AutoRepair/AutoPartsStore with the AggregateRating of both review paths, Product/Offer at the public price only, Article/ImageObject), robots.txt (private sections disallowed), /sitemap.xml index of /sitemaps/{pages,shops,parts-sellers,parts,showcases}.xml with hreflang alternates, built from public reads under a call budget and cached 6 h. Server data: cached public reads (60 s TTL, shared in-flight promise, 404/410 as results) and a page context with the browser's time zone and price display. Media boxes with fixed aspect ratios, lazy loading, an eager LCP image and placeholders while media are private (BA-06). One P2 fix: the BFF allowlist dropped every route with an {org_id} parameter, which also blocked follows/favorites and the /v1/public/orgs/{org_id}/… reads; it now excludes only the organization scope /v1/orgs/{org_id}/… (170 consumer + 18 fleet-driver routes, DI-40). Acceptance: (1) view-source of a provider page has the content, JSON-LD, canonical and hreflang, no phone, no trade price, no private data — verified by E2E; (2) Follow/Save as a guest goes through sign-in and completes on return — verified in the browser (Follow) and by DOM tests (Save, Helpful, Ask about stock, Request); (3) suspended and removed content: the backend answers 404 for both (DI-37), so the pages answer 404 + noindex; the documented states (suspended 200 + noindex, removed 200 + noindex per OQ-14) are wired to a 410 and render as soon as the backend signals it.

deviations: Suspended, merged, unpublished and removed records all answer 404 from public.org_get / public.inventory_get / showcases.get, and PublicOrgProfile has no merged_into (DI-37). So: no 301 for merged duplicates, no "not currently available" page for suspended businesses, no "no longer available" page for removed parts and showcases — all are 404 + noindex. The 410 branch (SystemPage suspended or gone, 200 + noindex, OQ-14) is built and unit-tested through the read cache, ready for a backend signal.
Permanent redirects (wrong slug, shop ↔ parts-seller for single-role organizations) are 308 (Next.js permanentRedirect), not 301; search engines treat both as permanent.

The phone number is not in the page HTML or the JSON-LD: Call loads public.org_get through the BFF on click and shows tel:/WhatsApp links (Docs/22 open point 7 unresolved; DI-41). JSON-LD therefore has no telephone.

Not on the profiles yet: Report (W-RPT-01 is P8), Write a review (P11), the interactive map on click (P6; the static preview links to /<locale>/map), the AI review-theme summary (no public read, DI-39), "Why you are seeing this" (Help Me, P10), Save on posts (DI-06).

W-PUB-05 shows showcases (portfolio items, showcases.get) only: posts have no single public read (posts.public_list lists per organization behind community.feed.enabled; consumer posts DI-02). The consent indicator ("Customer approved these photos") is omitted because PublicPortfolioItem has no consent field (DI-39); published showcases tied to a visit always had the customer's consent.
Part page without a stock "last updated" time and without AI alternatives (no public fields, DI-39); vendor fitment coverage shows the coverage level (brand/model) instead of a confidence (no field).

Landing city: no IP-based detection (optional in the plan); the city comes from ?city= or the cp_city cookie and the section asks for a city until one is chosen. The popular list is the first six providers of search.run (search_mode providers, entry_point directory_page) for the city; the hero links Help Me and the map (P6/P10 placeholders).

"Fit for your car", "Only my car", "Fits my car" and the fitment highlight use a signed-in user's active vehicle (names via the taxonomy, DI-27); guests have no car on these pages (the landing hero passes its picker to the search page only).

Sitemaps come from public reads (DI-38): providers and vendors from a search per pilot city (default radius), showcases from each provider's first portfolio page, parts from each vendor's first page per part category and language (an item is listed when found in both languages). Budgets: 3 search pages per city and mode, 100 portfolio reads, 50 vendor reads, 40 part searches per language; cached 6 h.

P2 allowlist fix (DI-40, GD-08 P5 amendment): routes naming an organization as their target are consumer routes now (follows.put/delete, favorites.put/delete, public.org_reviews, public.org_portfolio, public.org_inventory_search, public.availability, posts.public_list).

Request buttons go to /<locale>/help?provider=<org_id>&location=<location_id>&slot=<ISO start> (ids and a time only, GD-14); the request step that reads them is P10. Slots are grouped by day so the buttons stay short.

Tests of earlier stages touched: shell.spec keyboard test scopes "Browse on map" to the header (the landing hero has a link of the same name); allowlist.test counts 170 consumer routes and checks the newly admitted ones. The JSON-LD script carries the request nonce, so security.spec's "every server-sent script has the nonce" rule stays strict.
robots.txt is rendered at request time (dynamic): prerendered at build it would name the build-time origin.

Found on the way: a constant exported from a 'use client' module reaches server components as a client reference, not its value (the landing ignored the city cookie). Shared constants live in plain modules (src/features/landing/city-cookie.ts).

Local E2E needs the backend without CARPAL_SIGNIN_URL (pwa/README.md listed https://localhost:3000/id/signin): its default <issuer>/signin is rewritten by the /id proxy to the PWA's own origin, an explicit https://localhost:3000 URL breaks the browser sign-in on :3100. README corrected.
notes_for_next: P6: /<locale>/search reads sessionStorage "cp:pending-search" — now {text, node?, vehicle?: {brand_node_id, model_node_id?, series_node_id?}, city?, at}; send the vehicle as filters and the city as chosen_city for guests (BA-16). When a result card opens a profile, call saveSearchOrigin({orgId, sessionId, resultId}) from @/features/profiles, so Call there records search.result_event 'selected' (DI-10). Directory pages can reuse OrgCard, RatingLine, OrgBadges, pageMetadata/JsonLd/schema builders and publicRead (cached, 404/410 as results); add a "directories" kind to SitemapSource. P11: put Write a review into the Reviews section (src/features/profiles/reviews.tsx; vendors use the Verified purchase wording) and show "Approved by the business and CarPal" reviews as built.

Server components must never import values (constants, helpers) from a 'use client' module — they arrive as client references. Pure helpers live in view-model.ts / plain modules (profiles index re-exports both kinds).

DI-26 measurement (backend reads per page view, each cached 60 s per key): provider 4 (org_get, org_reviews, org_portfolio, availability; the @rail slot reuses them), vendor 3 (org_get, org_inventory_search [search bucket], org_reviews), part 2 (inventory_get in both languages for hreflang), showcase 2 (showcases.get, org_portfolio), landing 2 per chosen city (search.run, feed.discover — both search bucket), static pages 0. Sitemaps: about 30 searches + up to 190 reads per 6 h.

E2E seeding: tests/e2e/businesses.ts (businessUser through the real code flow, seedProvider with hours and availability rules, seedVendor with a part and fitment, taxonomy). report.summary: P6 done. Search entry (S-SHARED-01): the header search keeps its live suggestions and gains the device's recent searches (last 5, each removable, Clear all; localStorage, never sent); every hand-over (header, landing hero, recent searches, the search entry) goes through sessionStorage cp:pending-search to /<locale>/search, which runs search.run and replaces the URL with /<locale>/search/<session_id>?<enumerated filters> (GD-14). W-SRCH-01 (/<locale>/search/<session>): query field, car chip (signed in: the active vehicle → vehicle_id; guests: brand/model/series filters from a picker, BA-16), location chip (pilot city; Near me for signed-in users only, after the location_usage consent and a user tap; This map area after Search this area), mode tabs All · Shops · Parts · Parts sellers · Q&A (Q&A = questions.search, only with qna.enabled; Showcases hidden, DI-19), "Understood as" chips that can be removed (✕) or added (+ Add, taxonomy.suggest) — both refine the session with intent_override —, sort Best match / Distance / Rating; the red safety banner from the response's SafetyBlock (safety.check when the search itself failed) with Find urgent help, results stay visible; the filter panel (column from 1200 px, drawer below) with instant apply, URL-synced enumerated filters, option counts when the whole list is loaded (DI-42), Reset keeping car and category, and the availability note (providers without online booking drop out); result cards (rank 1-3 badge, about-distance, rating, verified and top badges, open now, price indicator, the first match reason and all reasons + explanation under "Why this result", next slot, parts that fit, part facts for parts results) with Request appointment (auth intent → /help?provider&location, P10) or Ask about part; 20 per page through search.page; empty state with Widen to N km / Show mobile mechanics / Remove filter: … / Help Me; vehicle missing banner, "less specific without a vehicle", vehicle-filter fallback banner, Switched to parts note, the quiet Help Me line for symptom text (Help Me draft saved); the map pane from 1200 px synced with hover in both directions, Search this area (refine with map_center), layer chips, For my car, Open full map, Hide map. Every change refines the session (or runs a new one for a new mode, text or car) and pushes a new URL, so Back returns to the earlier results; a reload or an unreadable session re-runs the request stored for that session in this tab (DI-17, GD-09 amendment 4); a 401 falls back to the guest request. Result opens record search.result_event 'viewed', search.result_opened and the search origin (so Call on the profile sends 'selected', DI-10); Request sends 'selected'. Map component (GD-12): MapLibre GL JS 6.14.0 loaded with a dynamic import only where a map is shown; its worker is emitted by the bundler under /_next/static/media/ and passes the existing Trusted Types default policy (no blob worker, no new policy); the region style URL when its origin is in the page CSP, else the built-in style (background + radius layers; no glyphs, sprites or tiles); one DOM marker per place rendered through React portals (shop = wrench in a circle, parts seller = box in a rounded square, hybrid = both, mobile provider = dashed circle + service-radius circle; rank numbers 1-3 for best-match orders; dimmed = smaller and outlined, still a button), server clusters with counts (click zooms to expansion_zoom), zoom / recenter buttons, legend, the always visible '© OpenStreetMap contributors'; keyboard: arrows pan and +/- zoom on the focused map, Tab reaches the pins in list order, L toggles the list on W-MAP-01; controls mirror in RTL, the canvas is dir=ltr; no WebGL or a failing library → list only. W-MAP-01 (/<locale>/map, noindex): top bar with query field and chips, car chip, For [car], Shops / Parts sellers, Open now (client filter, DI-45), Advanced search (the filter panel highlights: matching pins full, others dimmed, "7 match · 14 others", Hide others), location chip; places in view = every result card of the area's search (search.run / search.refine with map_center, 50 per area) plus pins without a card, in rank order or "Sorted by closeness to the map centre" after Search this area; pins from map.pins with the session id (ranks, reasons, highlight, vehicle relevance) fetched when an area is searched, not on every pan; selected place card with Request appointment or Ask about part, Directions and View; states: city fallback note, nothing here, fewer than 3 places for the car (Show all nearby), map failed (list only), offline. Entry points: Browse on map, Open full map (?session=), and the profiles' Open the map (?org=<slug>&place=<location_id>: centred on the business and its pin selected; ids only). Directions (S-SHARED-10): one shared menu for profiles, parts, map and search: the region's web apps with the destination only, the phone's map app on Android (geo:) and iOS (Apple Maps), Copy address, approximate addresses show the area and the 'exact address with the confirmed appointment' note, Remember my choice (me.preferences navigation_app_key with ETag when signed in, the cp_nav cookie otherwise) — a remembered app becomes a direct "Directions in Neshan" link with Other map apps next to it; map.directions_tapped. Location (P6.T6): the browser position only after a tap on Near me and only with an active location_usage consent (consents.list; the consent step grants it with consents.grant; 403 LOCATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED reopens it); default precision, rounded to 5 decimals, in request bodies only. W-PUB-04 directory pages (/<locale>/<city>/<category>[/<brand>] and /<locale>/<city>/<brand>; SSR; cp-ssr may call search.run, DI-14): slugs resolved through the region config and the cached taxonomy (unknown → 404), H1 ("BMW Suspension specialists in Tehran"), intro counted from structured data (shops, verified businesses, verified jobs from the capability reasons — no AI text), series chips on brand pages (?series=, nofollow, canonical = the brand page, never indexed), the ranked list with the same cards and reasons plus Request appointment, organic-order note, the map in the rail loaded after the page load and only from 1200 px, related links (same search in other cities, other categories, popular brands), 3 related questions while qna.enabled; fewer than 3 providers → noindex + Widen your search; JSON-LD BreadcrumbList + ItemList; /sitemaps/directories.xml lists city × top-level category pages with ≥ 3 providers (chosen rule for open point 6). Acceptance: (1) a Persian query (جلوبندی …) and the same in Latin letters (jolobandi …) both show the suspension chip and the ranked seeded provider with its reason; safety words (tormoz nemigire) show the red banner while the results stay visible — E2E; (2) no search text or coordinates in any page URL or request URL (every BFF call is a browser request; checked for each request of the E2E flows) and none in the backend's request log (route only); the BFF writes no access log; (3) the map works with the built-in style and with a real style URL (the region's style host intercepted and served a style) — E2E data-basemap fallback / remote.

map.pins has no open-now filter (its filters cover rating, verified, services, modes, price, types, badges, fleet/EV/warranty, languages, vendor fields, DI-45): Open now on the map filters pins and list on the client by open_now. Advanced search uses the same filter panel in highlight mode (matches_filters), as S-SHARED-03 says.

There is no read of a session's first page (search.page needs a cursor, DI-46): the session's response lives in the tab's query cache; a reload re-runs the request stored for that session in sessionStorage and replaces the URL with the new session id. A shared link carries no text (GD-14): it runs a search from the URL's enumerated filters only.
search.result_event: 'viewed' is sent when a result is opened (link click, also Ctrl/Cmd/middle click), 'selected' for Request on a card and for Call on the profile opened from a result (DI-10).

Map style and CSP: the proxy cannot read config.client, so the page CSP admits the origins of CARPAL_PWA_MAP_STYLE_URL and the pilot region file's style_url/tiles_url (src/server/map-config.ts); a live config.client style on another origin is not used (built-in style instead). The pilot placeholder host cdn.carpal.app does not resolve, so every first map of a tab logs one failed request (net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED) and the failure is remembered for 10 minutes per tab.

MapLibre's stylesheet is not imported: map.css carries the few canvas and marker rules (logical properties, the canvas container is dir=ltr), because importing it through the map feature's index would add 83 kB of CSS to every profile page. No MapLibre controls or popups (they use innerHTML, refused by Trusted Types); zoom, recenter, legend, attribution and the selected-place card are React.

The P3 amendment expected MapLibre to need a named Trusted Types policy and worker-src blob:. With MapLibre 6 the worker URL is a bundler asset (new URL('maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs', import.meta.url)) under /_next/static/media/, which the existing default policy and worker-src 'self' admit — no CSP change. Verified in the production build by the map E2E (no CSP violation).

Directory pages: brand combinations and series refinements are linked but not listed in the sitemap; city × top-level category pages are listed when search.run finds ≥ 3 providers, cities in region order and categories in taxonomy order, up to 80 searches per 6-hour sitemap build (MAX_DIRECTORY_SEARCHES; covers Tehran, Karaj, Isfahan and part of Mashhad with 24 categories). Series chips use ?series=<slug> (nofollow, canonical = the brand page, noindex). Intro numbers count the first 50 results only.
Search and map pages have no right rail: empty @rail/{search,map} pages plus a shell rule (.pwa-columns:has(.pwa-wide-page) without a rail) give them the full width; other pages keep the P3 grid.
The search page waits for a confirmed session view (dataUpdatedAt > 0) before its first search, so a cross-site arrival does not search as a guest first (P2 notes, SameSite=Strict).

Not built (Should / later): compare view and Save search (out of scope), voice input, the map's user position dot and GPS-accuracy circle, offline saved list (P12), the "Did you mean…" spelling suggestions (no operation), Featured blocks (flag off). The Request buttons go to /<locale>/help?provider&location (P10 builds the request step).

deviations: Contract sync done early: shared/api-contracts regenerated at 1.1.0 (the backend registry had moved on with S10, so pnpm contract:check failed). Only what typecheck and the tests needed: allowlist test 171 consumer routes incl. search.session_get, bff.int.test expects 1.1.0, fallback config contract_version 1.1.0, MapPin / SearchResponse test fixtures, RefineBody.sort typed as SearchSort. P14.T1 keeps the rest (E2E stubs) and the 1.1.0 behaviour.

DI-08 storage CORS allows GET besides PUT (the plan said PUT + OPTIONS only): documents are served with Content-Disposition: attachment (SEC-UP-4), so an in-place PDF preview must read the bytes into a blob. Signed URLs still gate every read; no credentials, no exposed headers. Dev defaults to the local PWA origins; staging/prod list origins explicitly (CARPAL_MEDIA_CORS_ORIGINS). The production media host (media.carpal-usercontent.app, WP1) needs the same rules.
CSP: frame-src blob: on /<locale>/garage/* only (GD-15 amendment), for the PDF preview frame; every other page keeps frame-src none.

HEIC/HEIF: converted with the browser’s own decoder (Safari decodes HEIC; iOS file pickers usually hand over JPEG already) and a canvas; no WASM HEVC decoder is bundled — libheif/libde265 carry the HEVC patent question the backend declined too (backend OQ-08/GD-32). Where the browser cannot decode the photo the row says so and asks for a JPEG. OQ-19 asks whether to ship a decoder.

SHA-256 uses SubtleCrypto.digest on the page (it runs off the JavaScript thread in the supported browsers) instead of a dedicated Worker: Turbopack emits workers of our own sources as raw .ts files in production (P6 observation).

Service records have no free-text shop field (ServiceRecordWrite.provider_organization_id only) and the consumer API has no organization lookup besides search: the Shop picker offers the CarPal shops already in this car’s history; a shop not on CarPal is kept by name as a first line "Shop: …" of the description (DI-47).

C-GARAGE-09: StatusChange has no sale date, so Sold asks no date (DI-48). Export: "PDF for a buyer" is the print view saved through the browser’s print dialog; "Full data file" is JSON built in the browser from vehicles.get + service_records.list (costs optional). No background export job / notification (the consumer side has no export operation besides the account-wide DSR export, P9).

Category suggestions in "What was done?" come from taxonomy.suggest (rules), labelled "Suggested", not an AI label. The AI cards (maintenance tips on the Overview, history summary on the History tab) run on request, not on every visit (RL ai.user); tips become reminders only when the user adds them; with the AI off (503 AI_UNAVAILABLE) the card shows the AI-off state and everything else works; a flag that is off hides the card. The duplicate-record warning is computed in the browser (same date and category).

Issues: there is no issue delete operation; "Remove issue" sets the status to cancelled (reports the user made only). "Report an issue" (quick action) opens the add-issue dialog; Get help / Find help link to /<locale>/help?vehicle&issue — P10 builds Help Me. Leave a review on a record waits for P11.

List items carry no ETag header: writes on reminders and documents send If-Match from the ETag cache when the item was read on its own, else "v<version>" (the backend’s ETag form, SEC-IC-3; GD-09 amendment note). A 412 refreshes the list and says so.

Vehicle list: no "Document expiring" chip (vehicles.list carries no document data); the primary-vehicle star is "Use for search" (the per-browser active vehicle, DI-27). The edit form leaves mileage to the header (mileage log) and cannot clear an optional field once set (it sends only filled fields).
The owner sees the buyer’s first name only (backend VehicleTransfer.requester_display); the buyer never sees the owner (BA-04).

Redaction: the decision card is built (MediaAsset.redaction_status suggested → apply / not needed → job), but the backend suggests regions only for organization images today, so consumer uploads do not show it.

Garage pages have no right rail (full width master–detail, like search and map). The signed-in default rail shows "Needs your attention" (incoming ownership requests) and nothing when there is nothing to show; "Your car" stays in the left navigation.

Earlier-stage code touched: Dialog gains a panel variant (640 px from the inline-end) and no longer closes a parent dialog when a nested one gets Esc (React propagates cancel through the component tree); the header avatar button and the vehicle context chip are named by their visible text (axe label-content-name-mismatch on signed-in pages, never visited by earlier E2E); GarageBox links to the active car and to /garage/add; onboarding exports QrCode; DefaultRail shows the attention box; shared fields SelectField and DateField (Jalali in FA) in src/components/fields; lib/format/jalali.ts.
No new dependency.

Reactions: the contract has helpful | like only (DI-49): Helpful on answers (and posts), Great work = like on showcases (and posts), Thanks = like on comments; no hover picker with three choices (OQ-21). Reviews' Helpful is P11.

No viewer fields in the community reads (DI-50): authorship (Accept, Delete, Edit/Close) and 'already reacted' are inferred per browser (memory.ts: ids posted here, reactions given here, the author name the backend used) or by the session's display name; the server decides (someone else's content → 404, shown as 'Only the person who asked can accept an answer'). report.summary: P10 done. W-HELP-01 Help Me (P10.T1-T3) is a full-screen flow in the (flow) group. /<locale>/help is the landing with Describe (which car — garage cars or "Continue without a car", the description with the shared safety check while typing, symptom shortcuts, photos and 15-second videos as issue_photo, how urgent it feels, the safety notice with Urgent help, "Continue your case" and "Find shops by category" for everybody) and the hand-over of every earlier link: the Help Me draft of onboarding/home/Q&A (cp:help-draft, cleared once used), the garage (?vehicle&issue: the issue prefills the text and is linked to the request), the safety banners (?urgent=1: Unsafe to drive preselected) and the request links of profiles, search, the map, directory pages and favourites (?provider&location&slot&shop&via → a case at its Request step). Guests can describe and pick a category; Start asks them to sign in and restores the form afterwards (intent help.start; DI-04, OQ-04 default). The wizard /<locale>/help/<case>/<step> (case = this browser's case id in localStorage cp:help:cases:<user id>, holding the triage session id; DI-62) has the step indicator (Describe → Questions → Safety → Recommendations → Request → Done; Request → Done without Help Me), Save and exit, and the sticky "Your case so far" rail (car, description with Edit, the answers — each editable: a new triage replays the answers before it, the contract has no rewind —, urgency, likely area or category, shop, media) with the safety banner once shown. Start = triage.start (the server's safety check first); questions are free text with Not sure / Skip and the keys 1/2 (no answer options in the contract, DI-58), at most 5; Safety shows the case's urgency — the highest of the user's choice, the triage and the server safety block (do-not-drive → critical, urgent → high) — with the critical interrupt (stop-driving instructions, Find urgent help, Save and decide later = triage.complete create_issue, normal results only after "I understand the risk"); Recommendations = triage.complete(find_providers, location) read back with search.session_get, or a Help Me search (search.run entry_point help_me with the category or the triage's symptom/systems/service as chips) for AI off, a changed category or location (city, or Near me after the location consent); the 3 recommended shops as wide cards with all reasons and the explanation, Compare (table), Map (numbered 1-3), more matches, safety-critical cases ordered open-now/soonest first, low confidence = "General inspection recommended", no match = Widen to 100 km / parts / Ask the community, See more shops (W-SRCH-01 with the same search). AI off (flag off, or 503 AI_UNAVAILABLE keeping Problem.safety) goes Safety → the category picker; requests then carry no triage. The shared Request step (Docs/55 §4.7/§4.9) reads the shop by slug (public.org_get, DI-60), shows the car, the description (Help Me: the user's own words, editable; without: "What do you need?" + optional category + "Describe it with Help Me", "Triage: not provided"), service type and mode, urgency, the 14-day openings of public.availability as a day grid with up to 3 choices in priority order (a slot picked on the profile is preselected) or, without published openings, Request anyway (day + part of the day at the shop's time zone, BA-19), a note with the safety check (sending stays possible), photos (appointment_photo), What to share (vehicle details always; service history for this appointment = share_history, off until turned on — OQ-25; photos) and the contact channel. "Preview what the shop receives" saves a draft (appointments.create submit=false) and shows pre_visit.requester_get; Send turns that draft into the request (update + draft → requested) or creates it (submit=true); a draft whose fixed parts changed is cancelled ("replaced") and made again (DI-61); a guest-era match_result_id refused by the server is dropped once. Failures in one message each: the caps (429: 3 open per shop, 10 in all, 7 days after a no-show; never retried), unverified contact (link to Settings), times, description, mode, shop, car, capacity, changed draft, network. Done shows the reference, what happens next, the public area with Directions, Track request, Back to home, Add another issue and Cancel request (PushOffer placeholder for P12). W-APP-01 (P10.T4) /<locale>/appointments[/<id>]?seg=… is master–detail (two columns from 1024 px): Needs your action (proposed time, draft, check-in now) above the segments Upcoming/Requested/Past/Cancelled; the detail has the status and reference, the action card per status (Accept / Suggest another time / Decline; Send or Discard a draft; Change times while requested; I've arrived from 2 h before, Running late; work in progress with parts note, estimate and completion window; the completion banner with the service record; cancelled/no-show with the reason and "Send the same request to another shop"), the timeline from appointments.history, When and where (map preview, exact address once confirmed, Directions, Add to calendar: .ics, Google, Outlook, Call through the public profile), vehicle and issue with the printable pre-visit report drawer, the notes thread, Cancel with reasons and the late warning; open appointments are read again every 30 s while visible. /l/ci (P10.T5) checks in from the mailed link for guests and signed-in users (DI-23): token from the fragment, removed from the address bar, sent only on "I've arrived"; 409 outside the window and 410 expired explained. P10.T6: the home's Needs your attention shows proposed times and visits in the next 24 h; notifications get Accept time (proposed time) and Directions (reminder); every request link carries the shop slug and the source (requestHref(…, { slug, via })), Book again from favourites included. P10.T7: tests/e2e/help.spec.ts runs Sara Ch. 6-8 in FA against the stub (describe the clunk → question → Safety → Reza near her via Near me → Request anyway with history shared → preview with the Help Me summary → sent → the shop confirms through the API → the mailed ci link → checked in → in progress → completed with the service record) and AI off via the flag (the server's 503 with safety and fallback_path through the BFF, then category → request → "Triage: not provided"), axe on every step. Your visit on … is attached"); no visit → Path 2 "No appointment — the shop and CarPal will check this review" and the button reads Send for approval. Blocked eligibility explains member_of_subject, already_reviewed (→ My Activity), velocity_limit (5 per 24 h), unverified_contact (→ Settings) and subject_not_published. The form: overall stars (required) and the subject's sub-ratings as native radio groups (one tab stop, arrow keys, Clear), Would you return? (providers), optional title, the text (10-5000, counter) with the hint per subject, photos (UploadZone review_photo), and the right column: tips, the privacy check (plates incl. Iranian plates and Persian digits, phone numbers, emails, links; per line, Remove deletes only the match, Keep hides it; texts the backend's W4 would hold are announced — reviewHeld is a copy of trust autoCheck with a drift test), review tags for the subject (review_tag applies_to; the ones taxonomy.suggest finds in the text are marked Suggested; only selected tags are sent) and "Shown as Sara M.". The draft is saved per user and shop ("Draft saved"). reviews.create (ATT, IDEM by the typed client) → the C-REV-02 panel: Path 1 "Thank you, Sara" + "Being checked — usually published within minutes" (or "by our team" for held text); Path 2 "Sent for approval" with the three steps; View on profile, View the appointment, My activity. Errors: verified contact, not allowed (velocity, member, visit not taken place), duplicate (finds the existing review → edit or open it), grant expired/used (→ write without the invitation), rate limit, offline (draft kept). ?edit=<id> edits an unpublished review (reviews.mine_get, mine_update with the changed members and If-Match).
